prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add persisted session diagnostics
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds persisted Session diagnostics through four Public/WebShell API pairs and a WebShell dialog with Context, Model statistics, Resources and Child agents tabs. Context describes the last committed main-model request; cumulative statistics include main, Hook and compression calls while keeping child Session totals separate. The resource inventory combines pinned Skills/MCP configuration with bounded saved discovery, and direct child invocations are paginated with independent child authorization.

Uses the existing journal, resources and Session projections without new tables or DDL. Bounded versioned snapshots preserve retry/replay identity, monotonic statistics and explicit missing/stale coverage. Storage version 3 and a separate CSI files profile `/2` protect diagnostic-aware recovery while preserving the existing `/1` contract and execution restrictions.

## Why it's needed

Managed Sessions currently expose only basic model context and scattered configuration/task information. Users need a durable diagnostic view that remains useful after a Session closes or its runtime is unavailable, without restarting execution or implying that historical MCP discovery is live connectivity.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm the diagnostic views use authorized persisted Session data, keep unknown/partial/stale observations explicit, and do not double-count replayed model calls. Review both ordinary and child Session access, including removal of visible data when Session permission is lost. Full CI acceptance remains pending.

### How to verify

1. Open diagnostics for an authorized Session. Verify all four tabs load through the product API and context categories remain distinct from provider token totals. Check that Hook/compression observations do not replace the last main-request context and child model totals are separate.
2. Inspect manual-only Skills, disabled/removed MCP selections and historical discovery. The view must not claim live connectivity. Page through direct child invocations; restricted or deleted children retain their parent invocation without an actionable child link.
3. Replay a model request and close/load the Session. Counts must remain unchanged; a subsequent model call advances the snapshot. Confirm statistics survive cancellation and that old readers are refused after storage version 3 is committed.
4. Switch Session/actor, close the dialog or revoke read access while a request is pending. Old responses must not reappear. Polling runs only for visible active statistics/trace views; diagnostic reads must not start runtime execution or MCP discovery.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the baseline contract contained 0 of the 8 diagnostic routes. The live baseline service was unavailable, so this is static gap evidence rather than a successful live baseline.

After: the contract contains all 8 routes. Chromium API-fixture checks passed at 1280 px and 390 px, covering all four tabs, closed-Session entry, restricted-child links, responsive containment and Escape focus restoration (`2 passed`). The separate packaged Harness + Spring + real MySQL case on the pre-rebase implementation passed with four scripted model requests, three successes and one cancellation; replay and close/load preserved totals. Browser fixtures do not establish a live backend-to-browser flow.

After integration with current main, root build/typecheck/bundle, 282 WebShell cases, 26 structured-question cases, four selected Hosted Session cases and both browser fixtures passed. The Java increment reached the shared local verification budget after exposing a CSI `/2` pin-recognition regression; it was corrected, but the corrected Java increment and real integration reruns remain pending CI. The separate E2E report distinguishes the tested revisions, partial run and prior results.

Review corrections in `30a7e354f7` cover CSI admission fixtures, immutable-profile reuse, bounded prepared context, shared counter invariants, resource coverage, trace request validation, route/SQL captures, child refresh and the narrow-screen dialog. The controlled 390 px test forces Verdana and checks all four tab states for overflow and overlap; both Chromium cases pass. Cold diagnostic restoration uses at most eight concurrent reads while retaining full historical validation. The Hosted fault artifact exposed a cross-Turn budget on recovery settlement; the carrier now retains a budget only for the matching Session/Turn, without resetting cumulative statistics. Focused TypeScript checks and builds are recorded separately from prior evidence. Java and full real-process acceptance for these corrections remain pending new-head CI; the shared local Java budget remains 599.08/600 seconds.

After rebasing onto main `80fd7c3353` (0.26.9) for the CI freshness guard, the full root build, root typecheck including integration consumers, and bundle passed with captured exit status. Refreshed selections passed Core restore/Hook/sink 66 plus journal snapshot 30, CLI consumers 210 plus basic-tool/recovery 21 (1,336 deliberate skips), and CI host-asset meta-tests 3 (78 deliberate skips). The earlier WebShell/capability-parity/browser results remain applicable to unchanged consumers; the diagnostic browser fixture does not mount the updated Sidebar. Java and real Hosted/fault validation are still pending on the final head; no local Java budget was added.

At prior head `37e9442f81`, [Java fast CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42300801565/job/128178138855) passed the H2 suite: 6,421 tests, zero failures, zero errors and 17 skips. This includes all 27 diagnostic contract cases, 40 model-context cases and 24 native CSI activation cases, closing the three concrete failures recorded at `30a7e354f7`. The correction also passes 142 local affected Core tests, targeted ESLint, full root TypeScript build/typecheck/bundle and independent Node 22 five-turn producer verification. All eight Linux unit shards passed. The full MySQL job subsequently failed one of 1,630 integration cases with `runtime_broker_execution_unknown`, while all 40 diagnostic MySQL and 38 diagnostic-query cases passed. Hosted failover exposed the separate B3 ledger-reader mismatch; full-profile acceptance remains pending. WebShell smoke cleared its browser-network startup failure on the single allowed [failed-job retry](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42300801384/attempts/2): shard 1 passed all 123 tests, and the complete workflow passed at the same head. The retained first-attempt traces show net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED on script/CSS dependencies before App startup; no source change or additional retry was needed. No local Maven/Java/MySQL verification was restarted; the shared budget remains 599.08/600 seconds.

At latest fix head `f506f0ce6f`, workspace recovery recognizes all three diagnostic resource kinds through their shared closed set, retaining unknown-protocol and byte-integrity refusals. The B3 gate reads normalized per-model metrics by stable keys and preserves the raw charged-output ledger independently; legacy reads and cost-continuity assertions remain. The complete recovery file passes 99/99 and the runner file passes 55/55; refreshed root build/typecheck/bundle, targeted runner TypeScript checking, lint, formatting and documentation references pass. The initial fixture type error is corrected and recorded in the plan. Two self-audit passes are clean; formal local review did not run because its required foreground workflow tool is unavailable. The [current-head full MySQL job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42323985034/job/128263518396) passes all 1,630 integration cases with zero failures/errors/skips, including all eight CSI worker cases and the diagnostic classes (40 and 38 cases). Current-head Java fast also passes its H2 suite: 6,421 tests, zero failures/errors and 17 skips. The earlier UNKNOWN cause remains unconfirmed; Hosted fault/failover and bot re-review remain pending. No local Java/Maven/MySQL verification or infrastructure rerun was started; the budget remains 599.08/600 seconds. Existing `history_maintenance` workspace-bundle refusal is deferred rather than admitted through an incompatible generic domain parser.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS; Node 26.12.1 for workspace builds and Node 22.22.3 for focused/browser tests; pnpm 11.24.0; JDK 21.0.8; disposable MySQL 8.4.11 with binary logging disabled and a 128 MiB packet limit; Chromium with desktop and narrow viewports. The local model endpoint was scripted. The task-owned database server has been stopped.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes span model observation, durable commits, storage-version negotiation, CSI recovery and authorized query/UI consumers. Bounded snapshots and history scans expose partial coverage instead of claiming unbounded history. The reviewed CSI guard correction passed CI, while the new Java, snapshot and recovery corrections require new-head CI confirmation.
- Not validated / out of scope: Hosted fault/failover and bot re-review remain pending on the latest fix head. The current-head SDK platform lanes and complete MySQL profile pass; the earlier CSI UNKNOWN cause is unconfirmed. Formal local review was not run because its required workflow tool is unavailable. Existing history-maintenance workspace-bundle support is deferred. Live backend-to-browser integration, stopped-runtime passive-read instrumentation, full actual-request context attribution comparison, concurrent MCP/config snapshot reads, MySQL EXPLAIN and process kill/restart have not been established locally. Sources, PR metadata, grouping/pinning/colors, tool/file/Skill invocation statistics and new child execution capabilities are excluded.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no DDL or table additions. Deploy readers that support storage versions 1/2/3 before enabling updated writers. Once a Session commits version-3 diagnostic resources, an old worker must be rejected instead of silently discarding data. CSI `/1` remains unchanged; `/2` does not broaden execution permissions.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-diagnostics-20261106/docs/design/2026-11-06-managed-session-diagnostics-and-organization.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-diagnostics-20261106/docs/design/2026-11-06-managed-session-diagnostics-and-organization.zh-CN.md). Implementation and validation plan: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-diagnostics-20261106/docs/plans/2026-11-06-managed-session-diagnostics-and-organization.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-diagnostics-20261106/docs/plans/2026-11-06-managed-session-diagnostics-and-organization.zh-CN.md). Both language versions cover the same decisions, constraints and acceptance gaps.

## Linked Issues

N/A — no linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

通过四组 Public/WebShell API 和包含 Context、模型统计、资源、子代理四个页签的 WebShell 弹窗，提供持久化会话诊断。Context 描述最近一次已提交的主模型请求；累计统计包含主模型、Hook 和压缩调用，子会话总量独立计算。资源清单结合固定的 Skills/MCP 配置和有界的历史发现结果；直接子调用支持分页，并独立检查子会话权限。

复用现有 journal、资源和 Session 投影，不新增表或 DDL。有界版本化快照保留重试/重放身份、单调累计统计以及明确的缺失/过期覆盖状态。Storage version 3 与独立的 CSI files `/2` profile 保护诊断恢复，同时保留原有 `/1` 契约及执行限制。

## 为什么需要

Managed Session 当前仅提供基本模型 context，以及分散的配置和任务信息。用户需要在会话关闭或 Runtime 不可用后仍有价值的持久诊断视图，读取时不重启执行，也不把历史 MCP 发现结果当作实时连接状态。

## 评审测试计划

确认诊断读取经过授权的持久化会话数据，明确表达未知、部分覆盖和过期观察，不重复统计重放的模型调用。检查普通会话和子会话访问，包括失去会话权限后移除已显示的数据。完整 CI 验收仍待完成。

### 如何验证

1. 打开有权限会话的诊断面板。确认四个页签通过产品 API 读取，context 分类与 provider token 总量分开；Hook/压缩观察不覆盖最近主请求 context，子会话模型总量独立。
2. 查看仅用户可调用的 Skills、已禁用/移除的 MCP 选择及历史发现结果。页面不得宣称服务器实时在线。翻页查看直接子调用；受限或已删除的 child 保留父调用，但不能提供可操作的子会话链接。
3. 重放模型请求并关闭、重新加载会话。计数应保持不变，后续模型调用推进快照。确认取消后统计仍保留，且提交 storage version 3 后拒绝旧 reader。
4. 请求尚未完成时切换 Session/actor、关闭弹窗或撤销读取权限。旧响应不得重新出现。只有可见且 active 的统计/trace 视图轮询；诊断读取不得启动 Runtime 执行或 MCP 发现。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：基线契约缺少全部 8 个诊断路由。基线在线服务不可用，因此这里只是静态缺口证据，不代表在线基线验证成功。

之后：契约已包含全部 8 个路由。Chromium API fixture 在 1280 px 和 390 px 下通过，覆盖四个页签、关闭会话入口、受限 child 链接、响应式布局和 Escape 焦点恢复（`2 passed`）。另一个基于重基前实现的打包 Harness + Spring + 真实 MySQL 用例通过：4 次脚本模型请求对应 3 次成功、1 次取消；重放和 close/load 保持累计值不变。浏览器 fixture 不证明真实后端到浏览器的完整链路。

集成当前 main 后，根目录 build/typecheck/bundle、282 项 WebShell 用例、26 项结构化提问用例、4 项所选 Hosted Session 用例和两个浏览器 fixture 均通过。Java 增量检查发现 CSI `/2` pin 识别回归后触及共享本地验证预算；问题已修正，但修正后的 Java 增量和真实集成重跑仍等待 CI。独立 E2E 报告区分测试 revision、未完成运行与此前结果。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add Skills and MCP self-service
prs.body:
## What this PR does Managed-only users can prepare Skill ZIP/tar.gz archives and authored stdio, Streamable HTTP or SSE MCP connections without a daemon or Session placement. A normalized preview leads to one-confirmation publication, optional encrypted Workspace settings, and explicit application to the current eligible Session through the existing immutable package and configuration-install lifecycle. Receipt lookup and frozen operation identities support interrupted installs; other Sessions retain their selected versions. Explicit Runtime Skill import scans only the selected Workspace's project roots and snapshots through its original ready owner. Personal HTTP MCP OAuth adds encrypted actor-owned grants, PKCE authorization, generation-fenced refresh/revocation, per-request token delivery, versioned Session bindings and execution-identity checks. Self-service publication, Runtime import and personal OAuth have separate default-off switches. The public/WebShell contracts, generated types, Java SDK and specialized management UI are updated together. ## Why it's needed The existing package lifecycle already supports resources and versioned configuration, but Managed-only users lack a way to author/import those inputs. Workspace service credentials also cannot represent a private user grant safely. This reuses the current package registry and recovery authority while making installation explicit, reproducible and limited to the selected Session; personal authorization restricts who can drive execution while retaining Workspace read permissions for results. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. On a deployment with self-service enabled, review and install a Skill archive containing a resource/script and each MCP transport without a local daemon. Preparation must not open a Session, request placement, connect MCP, execute a Hook/setup script or initialize a model. Credential values must remain outside uploaded packages and browser storage. 2. Keep two Sessions on different package revisions, update only one, and restore older content as a new configuration revision. Unrelated packages, independent MCP selections and base Hooks must remain intact. Busy Sessions, stale revisions, file-only profiles and read-only children must reject application without implicit upgrades. 3. Interrupt publication, settings and apply responses and retry the original operation identities. Saved content must remain distinguishable from active installation; an unknown post-commit outcome must retain the admission barrier until the original operation is reconciled. 4. Import a project Skill through the selected Runtime and replace/change its source or owner during the flow. Only that Workspace may be read; changed sources and stale/unready owners must fail without fallback or provisioning. 5. Personal OAuth must stay unsupported until provider configuration and cross-actor process/channel isolation are qualified. On a qualified deployment, verify actor/nonce/state/resource binding, refresh/revoke races, revocation during commit-to-ACK, explicit recovery, and refusal of another actor's prompt/approval/resume or unattended delegation. Disabling OAuth must block new authorization/token delivery while retaining query, revocation and binding removal. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: Managed configuration depended on published MCP definitions or daemon-assisted package preparation; there was no Managed-only standalone Skill/MCP authoring, Runtime Skill snapshot import or actor-owned HTTP OAuth flow. The installed global CLI did not recognize the Hosted profile, so no running global-binary HTTP baseline was measured. After: 44 real authenticated packaged-Hosted HTTP checks passed without Session/turn creation. Chromium exercised the actual installer at 1280px and 390px with scoped styles/portals, preserved unrelated pins and kept secrets out of package/pending storage; publication/settings/apply in that browser fixture were mocked. A separate check sent the exact browser-generated MCP bytes to the real packaged Hosted preview and received HTTP 200. These results do not establish the complete Java/SQL/Runtime installation path. A separate PR comment records the detailed verification report and remaining gates. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS 26.7.1, Node.js 26.12.1, pnpm 11.24.0, JDK 21 and Maven 3.9.14. Local browser coverage used Chromium and fixture-only credentials. Java used an isolated Maven repository; no real MySQL, production model or qualified personal-OAuth execution profile was exercised. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: configuration recovery, execution-actor admission and token delivery cross TypeScript/Java boundaries. All new deployment switches default off; personal OAuth additionally requires an explicitly qualified isolated profile and registered provider. Java admission/token handling is kept outside the existing size-capped facades without increasing their limits. - Not validated / out of scope: acceptance remains pending. The last local Managed server selection had 24 passes and 28 errors across 52 cases: 27 Spring context errors from missing OAuth Properties registration and one H2 SQL type error. The causes and subsequent recovery fixes were changed after the shared ten-minute local Java budget expired, so final Java compilation, `ManagedAgentApiContractTest`, `SurfaceRegistryGateTest`, full MySQL/Hosted crash recovery and end-to-end OAuth still require CI. Git/npm acquisition, daemon token import, personal stdio credentials, watchers and a new isolation platform are outside this change. - Breaking changes / migration notes: update the shared V1 schema baseline and recreate disposable development catalogs; no V2 migration is introduced. Legacy non-OAuth packages remain version 1, but an old apply request cannot overwrite version-2 personal bindings. OAuth packages are installed through authorization plus versioned apply after Session creation. Compatible Harness/worker capabilities are required, and pool capabilities must be homogeneous. Design decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria are synchronized in the [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/824db8ddffabc4be1e8c5709aee84fae5dac1b47/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-skills-mcp-self-service.md) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/824db8ddffabc4be1e8c5709aee84fae5dac1b47/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-skills-mcp-self-service.zh-CN.md). ## Linked Issues None.
中文说明 ## 此 PR 的内容 只有 Managed 的用户可以准备 Skill ZIP/tar.gz 归档和通过表单编写的 stdio、Streamable HTTP 或 SSE MCP 连接，无需 daemon 或 Session placement。用户先检查规范化预览，再一次确认发布、可选的加密 Workspace settings 保存，以及通过现有不可变包和配置安装生命周期显式应用到当前符合条件的 Session。回执查询和固定的操作身份支持安装中断恢复；其他 Session 保持自己的版本选择。 显式 Runtime Skill 导入只扫描所选 Workspace 的项目目录，并通过原始 ready owner 制作快照。个人 HTTP MCP OAuth 增加加密且归属于 actor 的 grant、PKCE 授权、generation 隔离的刷新/撤销、逐请求 token 发放、版本化 Session 绑定和执行身份检查。自助发布、Runtime 导入及个人 OAuth 分别提供默认关闭的开关。公共/WebShell 契约、生成类型、Java SDK 和专用管理 UI 同步更新。 ## 为什么需要 现有包生命周期已经支持资源和版本化配置，但只有 Managed 的用户缺少编写和导入这些输入的入口。Workspace 服务凭据也不能安全表示个人私有 grant。本实现复用现有包注册表和恢复权威来源，使安装显式、可复现且限定到所选 Session；个人授权限制谁可以驱动执行，同时保留结果的 Workspace 阅读权限。 ## 评审者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 在启用自助配置的部署上，不连接本地 daemon，检查并安装携带资源/脚本的 Skill 归档以及每种 MCP 传输配置。准备不能打开 Session、申请 placement、连接 MCP、执行 Hook/setup 脚本或初始化模型。凭据值不能进入上传包或浏览器存储。 2. 让两个 Session 使用不同包版本，只更新其中一个，再将旧内容恢复为新的配置 revision。无关包、独立 MCP selections 和基础 Hooks 必须保留。忙碌 Session、过期 revision、仅文件 profile 和只读子 Session 必须拒绝应用，不能隐式升级。 3. 中断发布、settings 和 apply 的响应，再用原始操作身份重试。必须区分已保存内容与已激活安装；commit 后结果未知时，准入屏障必须保持到原操作被核对完成。 4. 通过所选 Runtime 导入项目 Skill，并在流程中改变源或替换 owner。只能读取该 Workspace；源变化和过期/非 ready owner 必须失败，不能回退或申请新实例。 5. provider 配置及跨 actor 进程/通道隔离完成验收前，个人 OAuth 必须保持 unsupported。在符合条件的部署上，验证 actor/nonce/state/resource 绑定、刷新/撤销竞争、commit 到 ACK 之间撤销、显式恢复，以及拒绝其他 actor 的 prompt/approval/resume 和无人值守委托。关闭 OAuth 必须阻止新授权/token 发放，同时保留查询、撤销和绑定移除。 ### 证据（修改前后） 修改前：Managed 配置依赖已发布的 MCP 定义或 daemon 辅助准备包；没有仅依靠 Managed 的独立 Skill/MCP 编写、Runtime Skill 快照导入或个人归属的 HTTP OAuth 流程。已安装的全局 CLI 不认识 Hosted profile，因此没有测量到运行中的全局 CLI HTTP 基线。 修改后：44 项真实认证的打包 Hosted HTTP 检查通过，且未创建 Session/turn。Chromium 在 1280px 和 390px 下使用带作用域的样式/portal 测试实际安装器，保留无关 pins，秘密未进入包或 pending 存储；该浏览器 fixture 中的发布/settings/apply 使用 mock。另一项检查将浏览器实际生成的 MCP 原始字节发送给真实打包 Hosted 预览并得到 HTTP 200。这些结果不代表完整 Java/SQL/Runtime 安装链路通过。独立 PR 评论记录详细验证报告和剩余门禁。 ### 已测试平台 | 操作系统 | 状态 | | :------: | :--: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 环境（可选） macOS 26.7.1、Node.js 26.12.1、pnpm 11.24.0、JDK 21 和 Maven 3.9.14。本地浏览器验证使用 Chromium 和仅用于 fixture 的凭据。Java 使用隔离的 Maven 仓库；没有验证真实 MySQL、生产模型或完成验收的个人 OAuth 执行 profile。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：配置恢复、执行 actor 准入和 token 发放跨越 TypeScript/Java 边界。所有新部署开关默认关闭；个人 OAuth 还要求明确验收过的隔离 profile 和预注册 provider。Java 准入/token 逻辑放在现有受大小上限约束的 facade 之外，不提高其上限。 - 未验证或范围之外：验收仍待完成。最后一次本地 Managed server 选择运行 52 例，其中 24 例通过、28 个错误：27 个为缺少 OAuth Properties 注册导致的 Spring context 错误，另一个为 H2 SQL 类型错误。在共享十分钟 Java 本地预算耗尽后修正了这些原因及后续恢复问题，因此最终 Java 编译、`ManagedAgentApiContractTest`、`SurfaceRegistryGateTest`、完整 MySQL/Hosted 崩溃恢复和端到端 OAuth 仍需 CI。Git/npm 获取、daemon token 导入、个人 stdio 凭据、watcher 和新隔离平台不在本次范围。 - 破坏性变更/迁移说明：更新共享 V1 schema 基线并重建可丢弃的开发数据库，不引入 V2 migration。无 OAuth 的旧包保持版本 1，但旧 apply 请求不能覆盖版本 2 的个人绑定。OAuth 包在创建 Session 后通过授权及版本化 apply 安装。要求兼容的 Harness/worker 能力，池内能力必须一致。 设计决策、约束和验收标准在[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/824db8ddffabc4be1e8c5709aee84fae5dac1b47/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-skills-mcp-self-service.md)与[中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/824db8ddffabc4be1e8c5709aee84fae5dac1b47/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-skills-mcp-self-service.zh-CN.md)中完整同步。 ## 关联 Issue 无。

prs.title: fix(serve): treat a payload-invalid start reply as a definite refusal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A hosted tool execution whose `:start` request is refused by the Runtime Broker with HTTP 400 `runtime_payload_invalid` is now treated as a definite "never started" refusal: `execute()` rethrows that rejection immediately instead of falling into the observation loop. Only that one additional rejection is rethrown — the two 409 conflict codes, the polling path, and the unknown-execution reconciliation are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The Broker rejects a deferred tool payload it cannot encode (an unpaired surrogate reaching the JSON body) with 400 `runtime_payload_invalid`. The client only recognised the 409 `runtime_idempotency_conflict` / `runtime_execution_conflict` replies as "the invocation did not start", so the 400 looked like a lost start reply: it polled the observation endpoint until `observationMs` expired (120s by default, up to 180s), then surfaced the turn as a Hosted session that is recovery-blocked while the Workspace lease is still held. Nothing can ever settle that poll — a payload that failed to parse never became an invocation — so the only correct action is to fail fast with the Broker's own rejection.

**Path note (issue vs. fix site):** the deferred-findings row in #12993 carries the inline tag `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`, but the code that decides whether a `:start` rejection is definite lives in `HostedWorkspaceBroker.execute()` (`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.ts`), and the observation loop that burns the timeout is there too. This PR therefore fixes the decision site, not the tagged file; `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts` and `isHostedFileHistoryRefusal` are untouched. This is the second prescription offered in the issue ("treat the 400 `runtime_payload_invalid` at `:start` as a definite non-start"), not the prepare-time rejection.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the file's tests from the repository root:

```
npx vitest run packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
```

The existing `preserves a definite %s start rejection without polling` cases (409 `runtime_idempotency_conflict`, 409 `runtime_execution_conflict`) still pass, so the conflict path is unchanged.

prs.title: feat(channels): deliver injected messages into the running turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a fourth channel `dispatchMode`, `inject`: a message that arrives while the agent is already working in a channel session is handed to the running turn's mid-turn queue and read by the agent at its next tool-batch boundary, instead of being buffered until the turn ends (`collect`) or queued as a new turn (`followup`).

The queue lives in the bridge (`AcpBridge`), is bounded at 20 messages / 20,000 characters, and is drained in batches the ACP child can actually consume (10 per response; the remainder stays queued for the next drain). A message is reported as injected only when the bridge accepted it. Everything the running turn cannot represent falls back to the existing collect buffer and is replayed as its own turn, in arrival order: a rejected or over-bound message, another chat's/thread's message under a collapsed session scope, an unauthorized member in a shared session, a recognized slash command, an image message (refused visibly — mid-turn injection is text-only), and any message on a bridge without the capability. When a turn ends before the agent drained, its unread messages are taken back at the turn boundary and replayed as a new turn instead of leaking into the next one; `/cancel`, `/clear` and session teardown drop them with the same buffer-drop notification the collect path uses.

The round-1 review's 10 Critical and 9 Suggestion findings are addressed in the same commits: drain batching against the consumer cap, turn-scoped settlement, a collect-replay marker (not `alreadyPrefixed`), the shared-session authorization gate, the per-message `onPromptInjected` hook, arrival-order sequencing once the fallback is open, the aggregate/depth char bound, text-only media handling, the email dispatch-mode guard, and the daemon-bridge fallback diagnostic.

## Why it's needed

Closes #15630. Today a user who sees the bot going the wrong way mid-task has only bad options: `steer` cancels the turn, `collect` makes them wait for it to finish, `followup` queues a new turn that may answer a stale question. `inject` lets the correction reach the work in progress, which is what a mid-task correction is for.

The guarantees above are part of the feature, not polish: the failure mode of a wrong delivery receipt is silently lost user input, and a message accepted for someone else's turn executes work under permissions approved for that turn's owner.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit/integration level with mocked bridge and child; no live channel platform is needed. From the repo root:

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/email && npx vitest run
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/serve/channel-settings-store.test.ts
npx tsc --build packages/channels/base packages/cli
```

Behaviour to confirm, all named cases in `ChannelBase.test.ts`'s "mid-turn message injection (inject dispatch mode)" block unless noted:

- accepted injection calls `queueMidTurnMessage` only, logs delivered, fires `onPromptInjected` and does not buffer;
- a bridge rejection parks the message in the bounded fallback and every later message of that turn follows it in arrival order;
- both fallback bounds (20 messages / 20,000 chars) refuse visibly and tell the sender rather than dropping;
- a collect-buffer replay is never re-injected (`collectReplay`), so a parked message always becomes its own turn;
- undrained injections are replayed at the turn boundary (`ChannelBase.test.ts` "replays injections the running turn never drained as a new turn"; `AcpBridge.test.ts` "settles undrained mid-turn messages at the turn boundary instead of leaking them");
- a shared-session member who is not an operator is denied and buffered; another chat's message under `sessionScope: 'single'` is not injected;
- an image message is refused in-thread (text-only), a file attachment is buffered so its `saved to:` path reaches a turn (`WeComAdapter.test.ts` too);
- a recognized slash command is buffered, and the group-history backfill is composed into the injected text;
- `AcpBridge.test.ts` "caps one drain response at the ACP consumer batch and keeps the remainder queued" (queue 11 → drain 10 → drain the 11th);
- `/cancel` and `/clear` drop queued injections with a drop notification (`AcpBridge.test.ts` and `ChannelBase.test.ts`);
- the email adapter rejects `inject` (`packages/channels/email/src/config.test.ts`), and a bridge without the capability logs one diagnostic and buffers.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unauthorized member injects into an operator's shared session | text reaches the running turn and executes under the turn owner's permissions | denied, falls through to collect buffering as its own turn |
| Turn ends with 15 queued messages the agent never drained | text stays queued and is injected into whatever turn runs next | taken back at the turn boundary and replayed as a new turn |
| 11 messages queued, one drain | one response carries 11, child keeps 10, the 11th is lost while the channel logged it delivered | first 10 delivered, the 11th delivered by the next drain |
| Collect-buffer replay while another turn registers | replay re-enters the inject arm and folds into someone else's turn | marked `collectReplay`, becomes its own turn |
| Image sent under `inject` | `[Alice] (image)` injected; the picture is invisible to the model | visible in-thread refusal (text-only path) |
| Chat-B message under `sessionScope: 'single'` | injected into chat A's running turn; the answer goes to A | buffered and replayed as its own turn in B |
| Email channel with `dispatchMode: 'inject'` | accepted by config, silently behaved as collect | rejected at config with the durable-claim reason |
| Bounded fallback full | message discarded with one stderr line | sender is told, stderr records the refusal |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit and integration tests with a mocked bridge/child (Node 22).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `inject` widens what a mid-turn message can do. The injected text enters a turn whose tool approvals belong to that turn's owner, so the arm now requires `isAuthorizedForSharedSession` (non-operators buffer instead) and never crosses a chat/thread boundary the running turn does not own. The degradation contract is deliberate: anything the turn cannot represent becomes a normal buffered turn rather than lost input.
- Semantics: nothing is reported delivered unless the bridge accepted it; the queue is settled at the turn boundary; ordering between injected and parked messages follows arrival order; the fallback is bounded (20 messages / 20,000 chars) and refuses visibly.
- Behaviour changes: the adapter-facing `dispatchMode` contract gains `inject` (email now whitelists `followup`/`steer` and rejects the rest), and `inject` on a daemon-managed (`qwen serve`) channel falls back to collect with a one-time operator diagnostic because `DaemonChannelBridge` cannot hand messages to a running turn — promoting them needs a channel-visible promotion contract and is out of scope here.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run against a live agent child for drain timing (the tests drive a mocked child and bridge); the daemon promotion path is deliberately not implemented; queue capacity is the operator-facing global 20/20,000 bound, not a per-sender quota; images are refused rather than described to the model.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing modes — `collect` stays the default and the new mode is opt-in per channel; no config format change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15630.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增第四个 channel `dispatchMode`：`inject`。当 agent 已在某个 channel 会话中工作时到达的消息，不再等回合结束（`collect`）或排成新回合（`followup`），而是交给正在运行回合的 mid-turn 队列，由 agent 在下一个工具批次边界读到。

队列位于桥接层（`AcpBridge`），上限 20 条 / 20,000 字符，并按 ACP 子进程真正能消费的批量出队（每次响应 10 条，剩余留在队列中等待下一次 drain）。只有桥接层真正接受的消息才记为已注入；运行中回合无法表示的消息一律回退到既有 collect 缓冲，并按到达顺序作为自己的新回合重放：被拒绝或超出上限的消息、session scope 折叠后来自其它 chat/thread 的消息、共享会话中无权限的成员消息、可识别的 slash 命令、图片消息（明确拒绝——mid-turn 注入只支持文本），以及桥接层没有该能力的消息。回合结束时 agent 尚未读取的消息会在回合边界收回并作为新回合重放，不会泄漏到下一个回合；`/cancel`、`/clear` 和会话销毁会丢弃它们，并走与 collect 相同的 buffer-drop 通知。

第一轮 review 的 10 个 Critical + 9 个 Suggestion 在同一批提交中修复：按消费端上限分批 drain、队列与回合绑定并在回合边界结算、collect 重放标记（不用 `alreadyPrefixed`）、共享会话权限门禁、逐条 `onPromptInjected` 生命周期 hook、fallback 打开后的到达顺序、聚合/深度字符上限、纯文本媒体处理、email 的 dispatchMode 守卫、daemon bridge 的一次性诊断。

## 为什么需要

关闭 #15630。现在用户看到 bot 中途走偏时只有坏选择：`steer` 取消整个回合，`collect` 让他们等回合结束，`followup` 排一个新回合、可能回答的是过期问题。`inject` 让纠正能进入正在进行的工作——这正是「中途纠正」的用途。

上面那些保证属于功能本身而非润色：回执不实的失败模式是用户输入被静默丢失；而替别人回合接受消息，会让工作在「该回合所有者」的权限下执行。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

单元/集成层面，桥与子进程都是 mock，不需要真实 channel 平台。在仓库根目录执行：

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/email && npx vitest run
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/serve/channel-settings-store.test.ts
npx tsc --build packages/channels/base packages/cli
```

需要确认的行为（除注明外均为 `ChannelBase.test.ts` 的 "mid-turn message injection (inject dispatch mode)" 块中的具名用例）：

- 注入被接受时只调用 `queueMidTurnMessage`、记录 delivered、触发 `onPromptInjected`，不进入缓冲；
- 桥接层拒绝后，本条消息停入有界 fallback，本回合后续消息按到达顺序跟随其后；
- fallback 的两个上限（20 条 / 20,000 字符）都会明确拒绝并告知发送者，而不是丢弃；
- collect 缓冲重放不会被再次注入（`collectReplay`），被 park 的消息一定成为自己的回合；
- 回合结束时未被 drain 的注入会在回合边界被重放（`ChannelBase.test.ts` "replays injections the running turn never drained as a new turn"；`AcpBridge.test.ts` "settles undrained mid-turn messages at the turn boundary instead of leaking them"）；
- 共享会话中非 operator 成员被拒绝并进入缓冲；`sessionScope: 'single'` 下来自另一个 chat 的消息不会被注入；
- 图片消息在会话中明确拒绝（仅文本），文件附件则被缓冲，使其 `saved to:` 路径能在自己的回合被读到（`WeComAdapter.test.ts` 同上）；
- 可识别的 slash 命令进入缓冲；group-history 补全会拼入注入文本；
- `AcpBridge.test.ts` "caps one drain response at the ACP consumer batch and keeps the remainder queued"（队列 11 条 → 第一次 drain 10 条 → 第二次 drain 第 11 条）；
- `/cancel` 与 `/clear` 会丢弃排队中的注入并发出 drop 通知（`AcpBridge.test.ts` 与 `ChannelBase.test.ts`）；
- email 适配器拒绝 `inject`（`packages/channels/email/src/config.test.ts`），没有该能力的桥只记录一次诊断并进入缓冲。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无权限成员向 operator 的共享会话注入 | 文本进入运行中回合，按回合所有者权限执行 | 被拒绝，回退为 collect 缓冲并成为自己的回合 |
| 回合结束时队列里还有 15 条未被读取 | 文本留在队列，被注入到之后任意回合 | 回合边界收回，作为新回合重放 |
| 队列 11 条、执行一次 drain | 一次响应带出 11 条，子进程只保留 10 条，第 11 条丢失且日志记为已投递 | 前 10 条投递，第 11 条由下一次 drain 投递 |
| collect 缓冲重放期间又有回合注册 | 重放重新进入 inject 分支，被折进别人的回合 | 标记 `collectReplay`，成为自己的回合 |
| 在 `inject` 模式下发图片 | 注入 `[Alice] (image)`，模型看不到图 | 会话内明确拒绝（仅文本） |
| `sessionScope: 'single'` 下 chat-B 的消息 | 被注入 chat A 的运行中回合，回答也发到 A | 进入缓冲，作为 B 的新回合重放 |
| email 频道配置 `dispatchMode: 'inject'` | 配置接受，实际静默按 collect 处理 | 配置阶段拒绝，并给出 durable-claim 原因 |
| 有界 fallback 已满 | 消息被丢弃，只写一行 stderr | 告知发送者，stderr 记录拒绝 |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 使用 mock 的桥/子进程的单元与集成测试（Node 22）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：`inject` 扩大了中途消息能做的事。注入的文本会进入「工具审批属于该回合所有者」的回合，因此该分支现在要求 `isAuthorizedForSharedSession`（非 operator 一律进入缓冲），且绝不跨越运行中回合不拥有的 chat/thread 边界。降级契约是有意为之：回合无法表示的消息变成普通缓冲回合，而不是丢失。
- 语义：只有桥接层接受才记为 delivered；队列在回合边界结算；注入与 park 消息之间保持到达顺序；fallback 有界（20 条 / 20,000 字符）并明确拒绝。

prs.title: fix(cli): reply to SDK initialize only after config is ready
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The SDK `initialize` control response is now sent after config initialization finishes, not right after the request is handled. The initialize request is still handled first, so its SDK MCP servers and staged SDK-only config are in place before extensions load. If config initialization fails, the request receives an error response instead of no reply at all.

In protocol terms, the frame's meaning changes from "request accepted" to "SDK mode is ready": a client may treat a successful `initialize` reply as permission to send its first prompt.

The deferred reply is bounded. `initializeSdkMode` derives its deadline from the client's own `timeout.controlRequest` (`sdkInitializeReplyTimeoutMs`, minus a 5 s margin, 55 s when none is declared), so `initialize` has three outcomes: a success frame once initialization finishes, an error frame carrying the initialization failure, and an error frame `Initialization did not finish within <n>s` when the deadline passes first. In the third case initialization keeps running, readiness settles when it does, and prompts queued behind it are still served.

## Why it's needed

`initialize` was answered before `config.initialize()` ran, so the reply only meant "request accepted". A client that sent its first prompt on that reply then blocked on readiness; when the shared extension store was locked by another process, it waited out the ~28s retry budget and surfaced "Extension store is busy". Making the reply wait for config initialization turns it into the readiness signal clients already assume it is, and gives initialization failures a place to be reported.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use the controlled repro from the issue: hold the `extension-store/lock` and start a stream-json SDK session.
2. Send `initialize`, then one user frame.
Before: `initialize` replies while the lock is still held, and the first prompt later fails with "Extension store is busy". After: the `initialize` reply arrives only once config initialization has completed, so a prompt sent after it no longer races extension loading. Release the lock before the initialize retry budget (~28 s) runs out, otherwise the initialize request receives the "Extension store is busy" error frame. If initialization fails for any other reason, the same request gets that error response.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so N/A for screenshots. `replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` fails on the previous ordering (reply sent while initialization is pending) and passes here; `replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` covers the new failure reply. Existing dispatch behaviour is unchanged and covered by `ControlDispatcher` tests, including the deferred failure path: with `deferResponse` the dispatcher must send nothing and leave the reply to the caller.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests on macOS and in a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows not exercised.

### Environment (optional)

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts` (106 tests: 65 + 41).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the initialize reply now includes config initialization latency, so clients that pipelined work on the old "accepted" ack see a later reply. That is the intended protocol meaning of the frame.
- The reply is bounded by the client's `timeout.controlRequest`: a client with a tight budget gets the `Initialization did not finish within <n>s` error even though the session becomes usable a moment later. Measured on this branch with a declared 20 s budget and 22 s initialization, the error frame arrived at ~16 s and the queued turn then started.
- Not validated / out of scope: the read path still takes the exclusive extension-store lock; concurrent sessions sharing one config dir can still serialize. Only the readiness ordering is changed here.
- Known pre-existing limitation, stated because the reply is now a readiness signal: duplicate `initialize` request ids. `registerIncomingRequest` overwrites the entry by id and a cancel answers only one frame, so the earlier caller waits out the SDK timeout. The registry behaviour is unchanged by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15796

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

SDK 的 `initialize` 控制应答现在在配置初始化完成之后才发送，而不是在请求被处理后立刻发送。初始化请求仍然最先被处理，因此它的 SDK MCP server 和暂存的 SDK 专用配置会在扩展加载前就位。如果配置初始化失败，该请求会收到错误应答，而不是完全收不到应答。

用协议语言说，这一帧的含义从「请求已接受」变成了「SDK 模式已就绪」：客户端可以把成功的 `initialize` 应答当作可以发送第一条 prompt 的许可。

这个延迟应答是有上限的。`initializeSdkMode` 的截止时间取自客户端自己声明的 `timeout.controlRequest`（`sdkInitializeReplyTimeoutMs`，减去 5 秒余量；客户端未声明时为 55 秒），因此 `initialize` 有三种结果：初始化完成后的成功帧、携带初始化失败原因的错误帧，以及截止时间先到时返回的错误帧 `Initialization did not finish within <n>s`。第三种情况下初始化仍在继续，就绪状态会在其完成后落地，排在后面的 prompt 仍会被处理。

## 为什么需要

`initialize` 原先在 `config.initialize()` 运行之前就被应答，因此该应答只意味着「请求已接受」。据此发送第一条 prompt 的客户端随后会阻塞在就绪等待上；当共享的扩展存储在另一个进程中被占用时，它会等满约 28 秒的重试预算，然后抛出 "Extension store is busy"。让应答等待配置初始化，就把这个应答变成了客户端本就默认它具备的就绪信号，并且给初始化失败提供了上报位置。

## 审阅者验证方式

### 如何验证

1. 使用 issue 中的受控复现：占住 `extension-store/lock`，然后启动一个 stream-json SDK 会话。
2. 发送 `initialize`，然后发送一个用户帧。

修改前：`initialize` 在锁仍被占用时就应答，第一条 prompt 随后以 "Extension store is busy" 失败。修改后：`initialize` 应答只在配置初始化完成后到达，因此在其后发送的 prompt 不再与扩展加载竞争。请在 initialize 重试预算（约 28 秒）耗尽前释放锁，否则该 initialize 请求会收到 "Extension store is busy" 错误帧。如果初始化因其他原因失败，同一个请求会收到对应的错误应答。

### 证据（修改前后）

非 UI 改动，截图不适用。`replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` 在旧时序下失败（初始化仍未完成时就已应答），在本分支下通过；`replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` 覆盖了新的失败应答。既有的分发行为未变，由 `ControlDispatcher` 测试覆盖，包括延迟失败路径：使用 `deferResponse` 时分发器必须不发送任何内容，把应答留给调用方。

### 测试环境

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows     |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ✅  |

单元测试在 macOS 与 `node:22-bookworm` 容器中运行；未在 Windows 上验证。

### 环境（可选）

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts`（106 项测试：65 + 41）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：initialize 应答现在包含了配置初始化的耗时，因此按旧的「已接受」确认来流水线推进工作的客户端会看到更晚的应答。这正是该帧在协议上应有的含义。
- 应答受客户端 `timeout.controlRequest` 约束：声明了紧凑预算的客户端会收到 `Initialization did not finish within <n>s` 错误帧，尽管会话片刻之后仍会可用。在本分支上以 20 秒预算、22 秒初始化实测，错误帧在约 16 秒时到达，排队的那个 turn 随后正常开始。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：读取路径仍会获取扩展存储的排他锁；共享同一配置目录的并发会话仍可能串行化。本次只改变就绪时序。
- 已知的既有局限（因为应答现在就是就绪信号，此处特别说明）：重复的 `initialize` 请求 id。`registerIncomingRequest` 按 id 覆盖条目，而取消只应答一帧，因此较早的调用方会等满 SDK 超时。该注册表行为不由本 PR 改变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Closes #15796

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-runtime): pin the deferred acquire against close
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the acceptance test item 1 of #14674 asks for: a `/writers:acquire` parked in flight while `seal()` and `stopLocal()` start.

`reacquireWriter()` clears the grant for the whole acquire round trip and restores the expired one only when the acquire fails. Four behaviours on that path shipped with #14570 with no test pinning them. This PR pins them from a real client on fake timers:

- `seal()` does not resolve while the acquire is parked, then seals the grant handed back when it answers.
- `stopLocal()` does not resolve before the acquire answers, and no renewal timer survives it — the late grant is not kept alive.
- A refused acquire restores the expired grant and surfaces the `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError`.
- `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` refuses while an acquire is parked rather than joining a writer it never joined.

The last one is not in the issue text but sits in the same window and is the same data-integrity concern.

This is a test-only change; no production code is touched.

## Why it's needed

#14570 changed what `reacquireWriter()` promises while an acquire is in flight — the grant is cleared for the whole round trip and only restored when the acquire fails. Four behaviours on that path shipped with no test covering them, so a future edit to `seal()`, `stopLocal()`, or `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` could reintroduce a data-integrity bug without any test going red.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the file:

```bash
npx vitest run packages/core/src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts
```

Expect 209 passed.

Each case was checked against a deliberate mutation of the shipped guard and goes red when the guard is removed:

| Guard removed | Test that fails |
|---|---|
| `await this.acquirePromise` in `seal()` | close test |
| `await this.acquirePromise` in `stopLocal()` | local-stop test |
| `if (this.sealed \|\| this.locallyStopped) await this.sealGrant()` | close test |
| `this.grant = expired` in the acquire `catch` | grant-restore test |
| `this.acquirePromise` in `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` | join test |

`npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint` on the changed file are clean.

`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` reports no errors in `packages/core/src/managed-runtime`. Nine errors remain under `packages/core/src/utils/` (`ignore` / `mime/lite` resolution from the reused `node_modules` in this worktree), all in files this change does not touch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behaviour.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS is where the suite and the mutation checks above were run. I did not run Windows or Linux locally; Linux CI is the authority for the unhandled-error platform difference this file exercises, and it has not run against this branch yet.

### Environment (optional)

Local `vitest` only, no sandbox. N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Test-only. The tests bind to the current in-flight acquire semantics, so a deliberate redesign of that path will need them updated rather than silently relaxed.
- Not validated / out of scope: No full `npm run build` (the workspace `build` script fails in this worktree on `packages/browser-use` runtime assembly), no full repo suite, and not item 3's real-stack outage scenarios, which need a control plane plus MySQL.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14674 — this is item 1 of three, so it does not close the issue.


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

补上 #14674 要求的第 1 项验收测试：一个停在飞行中的 `/writers:acquire`，同时 `seal()` 与 `stopLocal()` 开始执行。

`reacquireWriter()` 会在整个 acquire 往返期间清空 grant，并且只在 acquire 失败时才恢复已过期的 grant。#14570 让这条路径上的四种行为上线，却没有测试钉住它们。本 PR 用真实客户端配合 fake timers 把它们钉住：

- `seal()` 在 acquire 停留期间不会 resolve，之后会对交回的 grant 执行 seal。
- `stopLocal()` 不会在 acquire 应答前 resolve，且它之后不会留下续租定时器——迟到的 grant 不会被继续保活。
- 被拒绝的 acquire 会恢复已过期的 grant，并抛出 `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError`。
- `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` 在 acquire 停留期间会拒绝，而不是加入一个它从未加入过的 writer。

最后一条不在 issue 正文中，但它处在同一个窗口内，属于同一类数据完整性问题。

这是纯测试改动；不修改任何生产代码。

## 为什么需要

## 审阅者验证方式

### 如何验证

运行该文件：

```bash

```

预期 209 项通过。

| 去掉的守卫 | 失败的测试 |
|---|---|
| `seal()` 中的 `await this.acquirePromise` | close 用例 |
| `stopLocal()` 中的 `await this.acquirePromise` | local-stop 用例 |
| `if (this.sealed \|\| this.locallyStopped) await this.sealGrant()` | close 用例 |
| acquire `catch` 中的 `this.grant = expired` | grant-restore 用例 |
| `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` 中的 `this.acquirePromise` | join 用例 |

`npx prettier --check` 与 `npx eslint` 对改动文件均干净通过。

`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` 在 `packages/core/src/managed-runtime` 下没有报错。`packages/core/src/utils/` 下仍保留 9 个错误（本 worktree 复用 `node_modules` 导致的 `ignore` / `mime/lite` 解析问题），全部位于本次改动未触及的文件。

### 证据（修改前后）

不适用——纯测试改动，没有用户可见的行为变化。

### 测试环境

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows     |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ⚠️  |

上面的测试套件与变异核对都在 macOS 上运行。没有在本地运行 Windows 或 Linux；Linux CI 是该文件所涉及的未处理错误平台差异的权威，但它尚未在这个分支上运行。

### 环境（可选）

仅本地 `vitest`，无 sandbox。不适用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：纯测试。这些测试绑定当前的飞行中 acquire 语义，若有意重新设计该路径，需要同步更新测试，而不是悄悄放宽。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：没有跑完整的 `npm run build`（本 worktree 的 workspace `build` 脚本在 `packages/browser-use` 运行时装配处失败），没有跑整个仓库的测试套件，也没有覆盖第 3 项的真实栈故障场景（需要控制平面加 MySQL）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

Refs #14674——这是三项中的第 1 项，因此不关闭该 issue。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): mask digit-led passwords and refuse an empty Harness user info in the upgrade command
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follows up the review items that arrived on #16110 and #16175 after they were settled, in the upgrade command's `start`/`verify` phases and their tests and docs:

- **A refusal hides everything up to a URL's last `@`, also when the URL parses without user information.** A password that starts with digits and holds a `/`, `?` or `#` ends the authority early, and the URL parser and `java.net.URI` both read its first part as a port: `http://svc:2024#Secret@harness:4170` is host `svc`, port `2024`, fragment `Secret@harness:4170`. The refusal printed such a value whole, password included, for the Harness URL and for the new `--server-url` query/fragment refusal. Both now print `http://***@harness:4170`.
- **Without the server's verdict, `start` refuses an `@` before the Harness host.** `http://@127.0.0.1:4170` and `http://:@127.0.0.1:4170` have no user name or password to the URL parser, but `java.net.URI` reads user information `""` and `":"`, and the Harness connector refuses them. With the verdict, the refusal now names that reason instead of the generic one. Without it, as when the configuration does not resolve, `start` let them through: it restarted the Harness for a value that a pool would drop every member over.
- **A health status of `0`, `false` or `""` is shown.** The health row and `start`'s timeout showed only `HTTP 200`, because a truth test dropped the status before it was printed. They now show `HTTP 200, status 0`, `status false` and `status ""`. A `null` status, like a missing one, still names nothing.
- **The URLs the two phases print go through the control-byte neutralizer.** These are the health URL in the health row and in `start`'s three outcomes, and the API URL. The text comes from the configuration or the command line rather than the endpoint, but an ESC or newline in it would still drive the terminal or split the row.
- **A Session id with a lone surrogate fails its row by name.** Such an id has no UTF-8 to percent-encode, so the row read `FAIL URI malformed`. It now reads `FAIL the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route`.
- **Tests and docs.** The Flyway reader gets the module-versus-module duplicate case that #16175's review deferred. The user guide names the condition it left out of `verify --tenant`'s API read: with `--actor`, the server must name a trusted actor header. The design docs state the masking, status and id rules as the code now applies them.

## Why it's needed

These are the items deferred as non-blocking by the last review rounds and by a verification comment, none of which landed before the two PRs merged:

- #16110: the bot's round 7 left six probes.
- #16110: the round-3 verification comment's Finding 1.
- #16175: one probe from the bot's round 4.

Five of the six #16110 probes are fixed here. The sixth is whether to model the server's plaintext-transport rule in the Harness verdict. That is a design decision and stays open.

While triaging the masking probe, the digit-led password case turned out to be a real leak, not only a wording gap: the docs promised `***` "whether or not the URL parses", and a parsing value printed the password.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
npx eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/managed-agent-server/distribution/bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade.mjs scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
```

Places to look:

- **Masking:** the `withoutCredentials` table and the `--server-url` battery cover the digit-led passwords.
- **The `@` before the Harness host:** both blocks cover it, the server.env fallback ("start and verify use server.env when the configuration does not resolve") and the verdict list.
- **Falsy statuses and printed URLs:** "health reports neutralize terminal control bytes from the endpoint" covers both.
- **Lone surrogates:** the id loop in "verify says why an API read failed".
- **Module-versus-module duplicates:** the Flyway reader test.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Suite.** 68/68 on Node 22.22.2 (x86_64) and on Node 24.14.0 (aarch64). Eslint and Prettier are clean.

**Mutation sweep.** Each mutant rewrites one guard in a scratch copy, runs the unmodified suite, and restores the file, checked by sha256.

**17/17 mutants killed**, one of them a known-killed control. Each guard this PR adds has at least one mutant:

| Guard | Mutants |
| --- | --- |
| Health status | a truth test in place of the `undefined` check; the empty status printed bare; `null` treated as a status |
| Session id | the lone-surrogate check dropped |
| `spellsUserInfo()` | always false; without the backslash rule; without the leading trim |
| Masking | the parser-only branch this PR replaces; the `--server-url` query refusal printed raw |
| Printed URLs | `printable()` dropped at each of the five URL print sites |
| Flyway duplicates | the first module not kept as the one named; the comparison limited to `BOOT-INF/classes` |

**Real systemd host.** The control plane, Hosted Harness and MySQL 8.4 are real; systemd is the real one; a scripted model serves the turn. Both arms run on the installed alpha.104 distribution, and only the upgrade script differs between them:

- `prev`: main's script, with #16110 and #16175 merged.
- `head`: this branch's script.

| Case | `prev` (main) | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No verdict, Harness URL `http://@127.0.0.1:<port>` | `Starting qma-e2e-harness`, then `The preflight failed`; Harness left running | refused before the restart: `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>", which carries an @ before its host, which java.net.URI reads as user information` |
| No verdict, `http://:@127.0.0.1:<port>` | same as above | same refusal |
| No verdict, `http://svc:2024#s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port>` | refused, prints `"http://svc:2024#s3cret@…"` (password in output: 1) | refused, prints `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>"` (0) |
| `start --server-url http://admin:2024#s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port>/zero` | refused, prints the password (1) | `--server-url "http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>/zero" carries a query or a fragment…` (0) |
| health `{"status":0}` / `false` / `""` / `null` | `HTTP 200` for all four | `HTTP 200, status 0` / `status false` / `status ""` / `HTTP 200` |
| `--server-url` with ESC, CSI and OSC-52 in its path | the row carries the raw bytes (1 line with ESC) | each shown as `�` (0) |
| a Session id `"\ud800"` | `FAIL session URI malformed` | `FAIL session the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route` |
| happy path `start`, then `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | `PASS health`, `PASS session`, `PASS turn … ended with turn.completed` |

The rig's configuration was restored byte for byte, and both units were left inactive.

### Review round 1

The bot's two suggestions are fixed in `4d2fdf3cd7`. The four refusals that quote a URL, and the row that names a Session id no route can carry, printed their value through `JSON.stringify` alone. JSON escapes C0 controls but leaves DEL and C1 bytes, such as the 8-bit CSI introducer U+009B, so a value could reach the terminal with them, and the id had no length limit.

Each of those values now goes through `printable(JSON.stringify(value))`:
- C0 controls keep their escapes, so every existing output is byte-identical.
- DEL and C1 bytes show as `�`.
- The quoted text stops at 200 code points.

A new test drives each of the four refusal sites with `\^[2K` in the value, and a Session id of 300 code points ending in a lone surrogate. All 6 mutants are killed: each site reverted to `JSON.stringify`, plus `quoted()` without `printable()`. The suite passes 69/69 on Node 22 and Node 24.

### Review round 2

- **R2-1 (Critical):** a `--server-url` with an `@` left after the URL parser reads no user information, the rest of a password that starts with digits, is refused before any phase dials it. `check` judges `--server-url` the same way. Every URL `start`'s three outcomes and `verify`'s health row print is masked.
- **R2-2 / R2-3:** start stops predicting `java.net.URI`. With a verdict `false`, the refusal is the server's, with a reason only where the value shows one. Without a verdict, it takes only a plain http(s) URL, narrower than the server's rule. The comment, both design records and the guide say so.
- **R2-4:** tab and `/@` cases.

On the real host, both arms run on alpha.112 with only the upgrade script swapped: prev = `4d2fdf3cd7`, head = `76fe9cfc8e`.

| Case | `prev` | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start --server-url https://svc:12/s3cret@127.0.0.1:9/x` | starts both units, dials `svc`, prints `s3cret` | refused, nothing started or dialled, `s3cret` 0 times |
| `check --server-url https://ops:s3cret@cp.example.com` (and the digit-led form) | `s3cret` twice in the plan | `check refused: …`, 0 times |
| no verdict, `http:/@127.0.0.1:…` | "carries an @ before its host, which java.net.URI reads as user information" | "is not a plain http or https URL, …" |
| no verdict, `http://127.0.0.1:…\@x` or `http://qwen_harness:…` | restarts the Harness, then fails | refused before `Starting` |
| no verdict, `http://127.0.0.1:…/@acme` | the preflight judges it | the same |
| happy path `start` + `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | PASS |

**Tests and mutants:** 71/71 on Node 22 and 24; packaging 29/29. A 16-mutant sweep killed 14. Of the two survivors, one showed the plan's mask was dead code, since `check` refuses first, so it was removed. The other got a test case and is now killed. `main` is merged in (781dd2d5c6) to refresh the lint gate.

### Review round 3

An autofix run handled this round first, in `affe6c5de3`. Commit `47dcb469a0` keeps two of its fixes and reverts two of its changes.

**Kept:**
- `refuseServerUrl` judges the value before the appended path.
- A `%` in a Harness path counts only as a full `%HH` escape.

**Reverted:**
- **The refusal of an `@` in `--server-url` is back.** affe6c5de3 removed it so that a path could hold an `@`, and rewrote R2-1's test to expect the dial. For `https://svc:12/s3cret@cp.example.com`, `start` and `verify` then dialled host `svc` on port 12, with the password in the path. An `@` a path holds is now written `%40`. The docs say so, and a test pins a proxy prefix spelled that way.
- **The plan's `--server-url` is printed as given again.** affe6c5de3 printed it through `shown()`, which turned a control character into `�` and masked the text before an `@`, so the printed command was not the one to run.

**New in `47dcb469a0`:**
- **R2-2, finished:** the no-verdict Harness rule follows `java.net.URI`'s host grammar too. It no longer takes an empty label, a label that ends in a hyphen, a last label that starts with a digit, or an IPv6 literal of any shape.
  - I checked the rule against `java.net.URI` itself, applying the same tests `harnessOrigin` applies. Of 2,000,000 generated URLs, the rule took 163,359, and the server refuses none of them.
  - The previous rule took 419,294 that the server refuses.
- **F5 from the verification round:** a control character in any word the plan repeats is spelled as the escapes of its UTF-8 bytes inside `$'...'`, which bash reads back to the value.
- **R3-2:** the usage line says what `check` does with `--server-url`, without suggesting it dials it.
- **F3 from the verification round:** the docs say why a path's `@` is refused and how to write it.

On the real host, both arms run on alpha.112 with only the upgrade script swapped: prev = `781dd2d5c6`, head = `47dcb469a0`'s script.

| Case | `prev` | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no verdict, Harness `http://127.0.0.1:…/a%zz` | starts the Harness, then the preflight fails | refused before `Starting` |
| `check --server-url https://` | plan prints `--server-url https:` | `check refused: --server-url "https:" is not a URL.` |
| `check --releases '<dir>'$'\e[2K''x'` | raw ESC in the plan line | `$'<dir>\x1b[2Kx'`, which bash reads back to the value |
| happy path `start` + `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | PASS |

**Tests and mutants:**
- 71/71 on Node 22 and 24; packaging 29/29.
- 9/9 mutants of this round killed.

### Review round 4

**R4-1:** the no-verdict Harness rule refused two host forms the server's Harness connector takes. The same Harness URL was then refused while the configuration did not resolve and taken once it did.
- An autofix run took the first form, the final dot of a fully qualified name (`http://harness.internal.:4170/`), in `1b2a8537ce`.
- `a69f65388a` takes the second form, an IPv6 address that ends in an IPv4 one (`http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:4170`, and RFC 3986's other `ls32` forms).
- The rule stays a subset of the server's. Checked against `java.net.URI` with 2,000,000 generated URLs, it took 169,787, and `java.net.URI` refuses none of them.
- Of the forms `java.net.URI` reads as a host, it still refuses only these, which the comment above the constants names:
  - a one-label name that starts with a digit, which the URL parser `fetch` uses may read as an IPv4 address;
  - an octet with a leading zero, which that parser reads as octal;
  - an empty port.

**Deferred notes, done:**
- The `@` refusal names its remedy: `; write an @ in a path as %40`.
- The JSON-quoting comment sits above `quoted()`, not `shown()`.

On the real host, both arms run on alpha.112 with only the upgrade script swapped: prev = `4fbb473d7d`, head = `a69f65388a`'s script.

| Case | `prev` | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no verdict, Harness `http://localhost.:…/` | refused before `Starting` | starts the Harness and reaches it; the preflight then fails, as no `java` is on the PATH |
| no verdict, Harness `http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:…/` | refused before `Starting` | the same |
| no verdict, Harness `http://127.0.0.1:…/a%zz` | refused before `Starting` | refused before `Starting` |
| `check --server-url https://svc:12/s3cret@cp.example.com` | refused, no remedy named | refused, `write an @ in a path as %40` |
| happy path `start` + `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | PASS |

**Tests and mutants:** 71/71 on Node 22; 3/3 mutants of this round killed; eslint and prettier clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

- **Linux x86_64 (Debian 13), Node 22.22.2:** the suite.
- **Linux aarch64, Node 24.14.0:** the suite.
- **systemd rig:** the A/B above, on the reference distribution 0.1.0-alpha.104.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** A refused URL that holds an `@` anywhere, for example in its path, now prints with everything before that `@` as `***`. That hides more of a value that is refused anyway, in exchange for never printing the rest of a digit-led password. A URL the command dials that holds an `@` in its path, as a base path the configuration sets may give one, is masked the same way, host and port included, since they could be the front of such a password. Other values the command dials are printed as before, except that their control characters are replaced.
- **Not validated / out of scope.**
  - Whether the Harness verdict should model the server's plaintext-transport rule (`BrokerSecurity.checkHarnessTransport`) stays open for a maintainer decision.
  - macOS and Windows were not run; the command targets systemd hosts.
  - No Java changes: the server already refuses every value this PR adds to `start`'s own checks.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** A `--server-url` whose path holds an `@` is now refused; write that `@` as `%40`. Otherwise, refusal texts change only in what they mask and in the new `@` reason.

## Linked Issues

Follows up #16110 and #16175.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#16110 和 #16175 收尾之后，又陆续到了几条评审意见。本 PR 在升级命令的 `start`/`verify` 阶段及其测试、文档中处理这些意见：

- **拒绝提示会遮掉 URL 最后一个 `@` 之前的全部内容，URL 能解析、解析器也没读出用户信息时同样如此。** 以数字开头、又含 `/`、`?` 或 `#` 的密码会让 authority 提前结束，URL 解析器和 `java.net.URI` 都会把密码的前半段读成端口：`http://svc:2024#Secret@harness:4170` 被读成主机 `svc`、端口 `2024`、fragment `Secret@harness:4170`。Harness URL 的拒绝提示和新增的 `--server-url` query/fragment 拒绝提示，都会把这样的值连同密码原样打印出来。现在两处都打印 `http://***@harness:4170`。
- **没有服务端判定时，`start` 会拒绝 Harness 主机前带 `@` 的取值。** 对 URL 解析器来说，`http://@127.0.0.1:4170` 和 `http://:@127.0.0.1:4170` 没有用户名和密码；但 `java.net.URI` 会读出用户信息 `""` 和 `":"`，Harness 连接器因此拒绝它们。有判定时，拒绝提示现在写明这个原因，不再给笼统的提示。没有判定时（例如无法解析配置），`start` 原来会放行，为一个会让 pool 丢弃全部成员的取值白白重启 Harness。
- **health 的 status 为 `0`、`false` 或 `""` 时也会显示。** 原来 health 行和 `start` 的超时提示只显示 `HTTP 200`，因为打印前的真值判断把 status 丢掉了。现在显示 `HTTP 200, status 0`、`status false` 和 `status ""`。`null` 与缺失一样，仍不显示。
- **两个阶段打印的 URL 都经过控制字节净化。** 包括 health 行和 `start` 三种结果中的健康端点 URL，以及 API URL。这些文本来自配置或命令行，而不是端点，但其中的 ESC 或换行符照样会操控终端或拆开一行。
- **Session id 含孤立代理项时，该行会写明原因再判失败。** 这样的 id 没有可做百分号编码的 UTF-8，原来该行只显示 `FAIL URI malformed`。现在显示 `FAIL the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route`。
- **测试和文档。** Flyway 读取器补上 #16175 评审延后的"两个模块含同一路径"用例。用户指南补上 `verify --tenant` 读取 API 时漏写的条件：给了 `--actor` 时，服务端必须配置可信 actor header。设计文档中关于脱敏、status 和 id 的规则，改为与当前代码一致。

## 为什么需要

这些都是最后几轮评审和一条验证评论里延后的非阻断项，两个 PR 合入前都没有落地：

- #16110：bot 第 7 轮留下的 6 条探针。
- #16110：第 3 轮验证评论的 Finding 1。
- #16175：bot 第 4 轮的 1 条探针。

#16110 的 6 条探针中，5 条在本 PR 修复。第 6 条是 Harness 判定要不要纳入服务端的明文传输规则，属于设计决策，仍待决定。

排查脱敏那条探针时发现，以数字开头的密码是真实的泄露，不只是措辞问题：文档承诺"无论能否解析"都显示为 `***`，而能解析的取值会把密码打印出来。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
node --test scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
npx eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/managed-agent-server/distribution/bin/qwen-managed-agent-upgrade.mjs scripts/tests/managed-agent-upgrade.test.mjs
```

可以重点看这些地方：

- **脱敏：** `withoutCredentials` 用例表和 `--server-url` 拒绝用例覆盖了以数字开头的密码。
- **Harness 主机前的 `@`：** server.env 回退用例（"start and verify use server.env when the configuration does not resolve"）和判定列表两处都有覆盖。
- **status 假值和打印的 URL：** 都在 "health reports neutralize terminal control bytes from the endpoint" 里。
- **孤立代理项：** "verify says why an API read failed" 中的 id 循环。
- **两个模块的同路径脚本：** Flyway 读取器的测试。

### 证据（修改前后）

**测试套件。** Node 22.22.2（x86_64）和 Node 24.14.0（aarch64）上都是 68/68，eslint 和 Prettier 无报错。

**变异测试。** 每个变异在独立副本中改写一处守卫，然后运行未修改的测试套件，再还原文件并用 sha256 校验。

**变异 17/17 全部被杀**，其中 1 个是已知必杀的对照。本 PR 新增的每处守卫至少对应一个变异：

| 守卫 | 变异 |
| --- | --- |
| health status | 把 `undefined` 判断换回真值判断；空串直接打印；`null` 也当作 status |
| Session id | 去掉孤立代理项检查 |
| `spellsUserInfo()` | 恒返回 false；去掉反斜杠规则；去掉开头 trim |
| 脱敏 | 退回本 PR 替换掉的只按解析器遮挡的写法；`--server-url` 的 query 拒绝原样打印 |
| 打印的 URL | 在 5 处打印 URL 的地方分别去掉 `printable()` |
| Flyway 重复脚本 | 不再记住最先出现的模块；只在 `BOOT-INF/classes` 与模块之间比较 |

**真实 systemd 主机。** 控制面、Hosted Harness 和 MySQL 8.4 都是真实的，systemd 也是真实的，turn 由脚本模型应答。两组都在已安装的 alpha.104 发行包上运行，只有升级脚本不同：

- `prev`：main 上的脚本，#16110 和 #16175 均已合入。
- `head`：本分支的脚本。

| 场景 | `prev`（main） | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无判定，Harness URL `http://@127.0.0.1:<port>` | 先 `Starting qma-e2e-harness`，再 `The preflight failed`，Harness 保持运行 | 重启前即拒绝：`which carries an @ before its host, which java.net.URI reads as user information` |
| 无判定，`http://:@127.0.0.1:<port>` | 同上 | 同样拒绝 |
| 无判定，`http://svc:2024#s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port>` | 拒绝，但打印密码（输出中出现 1 次） | 拒绝，打印 `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>"`（0 次） |
| `start --server-url http://admin:2024#s3cret@…/zero` | 拒绝，但打印密码（1 次） | 拒绝，打印 `"http://***@127.0.0.1:<port>/zero"`（0 次） |
| health 的 status 为 `0` / `false` / `""` / `null` | 四种都只显示 `HTTP 200` | `status 0` / `status false` / `status ""` / `HTTP 200` |
| `--server-url` 路径中含 ESC、CSI、OSC-52 | health 行带着原始字节（1 行含 ESC） | 全部显示为 `�`（0 行） |
| Session id 为 `"\ud800"` | `FAIL session URI malformed` | `FAIL session the API answered a Session whose id "\ud800" names no route` |
| 正常路径：`start`，然后 `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | health、session、turn 三行均 PASS |

rig 的配置已逐字节还原，两个 unit 最后都处于停止状态。

### 第 1 轮评审

bot 的两条建议在 `4d2fdf3cd7` 中修复。四处引用 URL 的拒绝提示，以及点名无法放进路由的 Session id 的那一行，原来只经过 `JSON.stringify` 打印。JSON 会转义 C0 控制字符，但不转义 DEL 和 C1 字节（例如 8 位 CSI 引导符 U+009B），这些字节可能原样进入终端，而且 id 没有长度上限。

现在这些值统一经过 `printable(JSON.stringify(value))`：
- C0 控制字符保留原来的转义形式，所以现有输出逐字节不变。
- DEL 和 C1 字节显示为 `�`。
- 引用的文本在 200 个码点处截断。

新测试在四处拒绝提示的取值中各放入 `\^[2K`，并用一个 300 个码点、以孤立代理项结尾的 Session id 覆盖 id 那一行。6 个变异全部被杀：五处分别改回 `JSON.stringify`，外加去掉 `quoted()` 中的 `printable()`。测试套件在 Node 22 和 Node 24 上都是 69/69。

### 第 2 轮评审

- **R2-1（Critical）：** URL 解析器读不出用户信息、却仍带有 `@` 的 `--server-url`（即以数字开头的密码的剩余部分）会在任何阶段拨号之前被拒绝。`check` 也以同样方式判定 `--server-url`。`start` 的三种结果和 `verify` 的 health 行打印的每个 URL 都会做掩码。
- **R2-2 / R2-3：** `start` 不再去预测 `java.net.URI` 的读法。判定为 `false` 时，拒绝依据服务端的判定，只有当取值本身显示出原因时才写明；没有判定时，只接受朴素的 http(s) URL，规则比服务端的更窄。代码注释、两份设计记录和部署指南都已同步。
- **R2-4：** 补了制表符和路径中 `/@` 的用例。

真机上两个对照臂都在 alpha.112 上运行，只替换升级脚本：prev = `4d2fdf3cd7`，head = `76fe9cfc8e`。

| 场景 | `prev` | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start --server-url https://svc:12/s3cret@127.0.0.1:9/x` | 启动两个 unit，拨号到 `svc`，打印出 `s3cret` | 拒绝，不启动、不拨号，`s3cret` 出现 0 次 |
| `check --server-url https://ops:s3cret@cp.example.com`（及以数字开头的形式） | 计划中出现两次 `s3cret` | `check refused: …`，0 次 |
| 无判定，`http:/@127.0.0.1:…` | "carries an @ before its host, which java.net.URI reads as user information" | "is not a plain http or https URL, …" |
| 无判定，`http://127.0.0.1:…\@x` 或 `http://qwen_harness:…` | 重启 Harness 后才失败 | 在 `Starting` 之前拒绝 |
| 无判定，`http://127.0.0.1:…/@acme` | 交由 preflight 判定 | 相同 |
| 正常路径 `start` + `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | PASS |

**测试与变异：** Node 22 和 24 下 71/71，打包测试 29/29。16 个变异中 14 个被杀：两个存活的变异里，一个说明计划中的掩码是死代码（`check` 会先拒绝），已删除；另一个补了测试用例，现已被杀。已合入 `main`（781dd2d5c6）以刷新 lint 门禁。

### 第 3 轮评审

这一轮先由一次 autofix 在 `affe6c5de3` 中处理。提交 `47dcb469a0` 保留了它的两处修复，撤回了它的两处改动。

**保留：**
- `refuseServerUrl` 先判定取值本身，再判定拼接路径后的形态。
- Harness 路径中的 `%` 只认完整的 `%HH` 转义。

**撤回：**
- **恢复对 `--server-url` 中 `@` 的拒绝。** affe6c5de3 为了让路径能带 `@` 删掉了这条拒绝，并把 R2-1 的测试改成期望拨号。于是对 `https://svc:12/s3cret@cp.example.com`，`start` 和 `verify` 会连向主机 `svc` 的 12 端口，密码落在路径里发出去。路径中的 `@` 现在写作 `%40`；文档已写明，测试也钉住了这样写的代理前缀。
- **计划中的 `--server-url` 恢复原样打印。** affe6c5de3 让它经过 `shown()`，控制字符会变成 `�`，`@` 之前的内容会被遮掉，打印出来的命令就不是该执行的那条了。

**`47dcb469a0` 新增：**
- **R2-2 补全：** 无判定时的 Harness 规则在主机部分同样遵循 `java.net.URI` 的语法。不再接受空 label、以连字符结尾的 label、以数字开头的最后一个 label，也不再接受任意形状的 IPv6 字面量。
  - 我直接拿 `java.net.URI` 核对了这条规则，判定条件与 `harnessOrigin` 相同。生成的 2,000,000 个 URL 中，规则接受 163,359 个，其中没有一个被服务端拒绝。
  - 旧规则接受了 419,294 个服务端会拒绝的取值。
- **验证轮的 F5：** 计划重复的每个取值中的控制字符，都写成 `$'...'` 中其 UTF-8 字节的转义，bash 读回来就是原值。
- **R3-2：** 用法说明写明 `check` 对 `--server-url` 做什么，同时不暗示它会拨号。
- **验证轮的 F3：** 文档说明了为什么路径中的 `@` 会被拒绝，以及应该怎么写。

真机上两个分支都在 alpha.112 上运行，只替换升级脚本：prev = `781dd2d5c6`，head = `47dcb469a0` 的脚本。

| 场景 | `prev` | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无判定，Harness `http://127.0.0.1:…/a%zz` | 先启动 Harness，随后 preflight 失败 | 在 `Starting` 之前拒绝 |
| `check --server-url https://` | 计划中打印 `--server-url https:` | `check refused: --server-url "https:" is not a URL.` |
| `check --releases '<dir>'$'\e[2K''x'` | 计划行带原始 ESC | `$'<dir>\x1b[2Kx'`，bash 读回来就是原值 |
| 正常路径 `start` + `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | PASS |

**测试与变异：**
- Node 22 和 24 下 71/71；打包测试 29/29。
- 本轮 9/9 个变异全部被杀。

### 第 4 轮评审

**R4-1：** 无判定时的 Harness 规则拒绝了服务端 Harness 连接器接受的两种主机写法。结果同一个 Harness URL 在配置无法解析时被拒绝，配置能解析时却被接受。
- 一次 autofix 运行在 `1b2a8537ce` 中接受了第一种：完整域名末尾的点（`http://harness.internal.:4170/`）。
- `a69f65388a` 接受了第二种：以 IPv4 地址结尾的 IPv6 地址（`http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:4170`，以及 RFC 3986 中其他 `ls32` 写法）。
- 规则仍是服务端规则的子集。用 200 万个生成的 URL 与 `java.net.URI` 对比，规则接受了 169,787 个，`java.net.URI` 一个都不拒绝。
- 在 `java.net.URI` 认作主机的写法中，它仍只拒绝以下几种，常量上方的注释写明了这些情况：
  - 以数字开头的单个 label：`fetch` 所用的 URL 解析器可能把它读成 IPv4 地址；
  - 带前导零的 IPv4 段：该解析器会读成八进制；
  - 空端口。

**已处理的延后项：**
- `@` 的拒绝提示写明了补救办法：`; write an @ in a path as %40`。
- 说明 JSON 引用的注释移到了 `quoted()` 上方，而不是 `shown()` 上方。

真机上两边都运行在 alpha.112 上，只替换升级脚本：prev = `4fbb473d7d`，head = `a69f65388a` 的脚本。

| 场景 | `prev` | `head` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无判定，Harness 为 `http://localhost.:…/` | 在 `Starting` 之前拒绝 | 启动 Harness 并能连上；随后 preflight 失败，因为 PATH 里没有 `java` |
| 无判定，Harness 为 `http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:…/` | 在 `Starting` 之前拒绝 | 同上 |
| 无判定，Harness 为 `http://127.0.0.1:…/a%zz` | 在 `Starting` 之前拒绝 | 在 `Starting` 之前拒绝 |
| `check --server-url https://svc:12/s3cret@cp.example.com` | 拒绝，未给出补救办法 | 拒绝，并提示 `write an @ in a path as %40` |
| 正常路径 `start` + `verify --tenant e2e --turn` | — | PASS |

**测试与变异：** Node 22 下 71/71；本轮 3/3 个变异全部被杀；eslint 与 prettier 无问题。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境（可选）

- **Linux x86_64（Debian 13），Node 22.22.2：** 测试套件。
- **Linux aarch64，Node 24.14.0：** 测试套件。
- **systemd rig：** 上面的 A/B，在 reference 发行包 0.1.0-alpha.104 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或权衡。** 被拒绝的 URL 只要在任何位置含 `@`（例如在路径里），这个 `@` 之前的内容都会显示为 `***`。这会多遮掉一些本来就被拒绝的值，换来的是以数字开头的密码不会再被打印出来。命令实际拨号的 URL 若在路径中含 `@`（例如配置给出的 base path），也会同样脱敏，主机和端口一并遮掉，因为它们可能是这类密码的前半段。其余实际拨号的 URL 照常打印，只是其中的控制字符会被替换。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内。**
  - Harness 判定是否纳入服务端的明文传输规则（`BrokerSecurity.checkHarnessTransport`），仍待 maintainer 决定。
  - 没有在 macOS 和 Windows 上运行；这个命令面向 systemd 主机。
  - 没有 Java 改动：本 PR 加进 `start` 自身检查的每一种取值，服务端本来就会拒绝。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明。** 路径中含 `@` 的 `--server-url` 现在会被拒绝，请把该 `@` 写作 `%40`。除此之外，拒绝提示的文本只在脱敏范围和新增的 `@` 原因上有变化。

prs.title: ci(release): only file issues on failure and reconcile stale ones
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Both fan-out release notifiers treated a cancelled run as a failure and filed an issue, and neither workflow had any path to close that issue once a later attempt shipped. Each notifier now reacts only to an actual failure of its build or publish job, and each workflow gains a success-gated sibling job that closes the bot-authored issue an earlier attempt filed. The shared release step behind that reconciliation now takes the issue-title prefix and the release version, so the CLI release and both fan-out workflows reuse one implementation instead of growing separate copies.

## Why it's needed

A shipped release could sit under an open failure report: release v0.26.3's VSCode companion run passed on attempt 2 while its failure issue stayed open until it was closed by hand. Cancellation also filed issues for runs that shipped nothing. Stale failure issues are picked up by the scheduled autofix agent and turned into PRs against releases that already landed, so the false report has a cost beyond noise.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From the repository root, run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/release-fanout-workflows.test.js scripts/tests/release-workflow.test.js`. The five new cases pin that neither notifier mentions `cancelled`, that each reconcile job is success-gated, checks out the workflow's own commit, calls the shared step with its own title prefix, and cannot turn a shipped release red. One case drives the script with a fake `gh` and two bot-authored issues whose titles differ only by workflow prefix, and asserts that only the matching issue is closed. The existing release.yml reconciliation cases keep passing unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, a cancelled build or publish filed `VSCode IDE Companion Release Failed for …` / `Chrome extension release failed for …`, and a passing re-run left it open. After, cancellation files nothing and a passing re-run closes the workflow-owned issue with a comment. This is CI-only behaviour, so there is no UI before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The script is bash and both jobs run on `ubuntu-latest`; Windows is not a supported target. Linux was verified inside a `node:22-bookworm` container with `jq` installed.

### Environment (optional)

Unit and workflow-contract tests only; no release run was triggered.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each successful release now runs one short reconciliation job, which comments on and closes only a `github-actions[bot]` issue whose title matches `<prefix><version> on ` exactly. A human filing the same title is never touched, and the step is `continue-on-error` so it cannot fail a shipped release.
- Not validated / out of scope: the notifier still has no dry-run guard and does not react to a `prepare` failure in the companion workflow; both predate this change and were left untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The workflows grow by about 1.5 KB each, within the size-ratchet allowance, so no baseline update is needed.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15840

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `ui.startExpanded` (boolean, default `false`). When `true`, the terminal UI starts with thinking blocks and tool output expanded instead of requiring Ctrl+O / Alt+T in every session.

The setting only seeds the initial value of the existing app-wide expansion flag. The toggle still owns the state afterwards, so Ctrl+O in an expanded session collapses it exactly as before. Both renderers are covered (ink `AppContainer`, OpenTUI `start-opentui-ui`).

```json
{ "ui": { "startExpanded": true } }
```

## Why it's needed

Retiring `ui.compactMode` left no way to express "I always want the reasoning visible", so the only option was to press the toggle at the start of each session. This restores that preference as a start-up default rather than a mode the toggle has to fight.

## Reviewer Test Plan

```
npx vitest run src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts   67 passed
npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli                  clean

```
