prs.title: fix(cli): report pre-send refusals instead of replaying answers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the client refuses a turn before sending it — the session token limit or a UserPromptSubmit hook block — the stream carries no content, and the shared result builder fell back to the previous turn's assistant message. A persistent stream-json session therefore reported the refused message as a success carrying the earlier answer. This records the refusal on the adapter that stream-json, json, and text output share, and turns that would-be success into an error result with the refusal text and no `result` field. An error the caller already classified keeps its own subtype but reports the real refusal as its message, and the latch is cleared when the result that ends the turn is built, so it cannot relabel a later turn. A refusal that lands after the turn already streamed text leaves that text as the turn's answer and keeps the success envelope. The error reuses the existing `error_during_execution` subtype, so all three SDK protocol definitions stay unchanged and this does not depend on #15358.

## Why it's needed

Consumers branch on the result envelope (`is_error` / `subtype`), so a refused message currently looks answered and silently repeats stale content — a shell wrapper that only checks the status proceeds with the previous answer. The issue reproduces it with a two-message stream-json session, where the refused turn returned `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the adapter suite from `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`. The added cases feed each refusal event after a previous assistant message exists, then assert `is_error: true`, `subtype: "error_during_execution"`, the refusal text in `error.message`, and the absence of a `result` field. They also cover the neighbouring shapes: text produced before the refusal, a refusal in a later model round, a caller-classified error, and a refused turn followed by a turn that answers normally. Each case fails before the change and passes after it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the refused turn emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<previous answer>"}`. After: it emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}` with no `result`. This is a non-user-visible protocol change in headless output, so there is no TUI before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified inside a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows was not exercised, and the change has no platform-specific code.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the latch is cleared when a result is built and consumed by that same build, so it cannot relabel a later turn's result. Refusals still end the turn; in a single-shot `-p` run a refusal that has nothing of its own to report exits with code 1 so the process status agrees with the error envelope, while a refusal that lands after the turn streamed text keeps the success envelope and exits 0. A persistent `--input-format stream-json` session ignores the per-turn status and keeps its existing behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: the max-turns sibling refusal stays with #15358.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — no new subtype, no configuration, no SDK type change. Single-shot `-p` exit status for these two refusals changes from 0 to 1 for scripts that relied on the old value.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15704

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当客户端在发送前拒绝一轮请求（会话 token 上限，或 UserPromptSubmit hook 拦截）时，流里没有任何内容，而共用的 result 构建逻辑会回退到上一轮的助手消息。持久化的 stream-json 会话因此把被拒绝的消息报告成一次成功，并带上之前的答案。本改动在 stream-json、json、text 三种输出共用的适配器上记录拒绝原因，把原本会生成的成功结果转换成错误结果：带拒绝原因、不带 `result` 字段。调用方已经判定为错误的结果保留原有 subtype，但文案换成真实的拒绝原因；记录在构建 result 时清空，因此不会污染后续回合。拒绝发生时本轮已经输出过文本的，那段文本就是本轮的答案，结果保持成功信封。错误复用现有的 `error_during_execution` subtype，因此三套 SDK 的协议定义都不需要改，也不依赖 #15358。

## 为什么需要

调用方根据 result 信封（`is_error` / `subtype`）分支处理，现在被拒绝的消息看起来像已回答，并且静默重复旧内容——只判断退出码的 shell 包装脚本会拿着上一轮答案继续执行。issue 里用两条消息的 stream-json 会话复现：被拒绝的一轮返回 `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`。

## 评审验证方式

在 `packages/cli` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`。新增用例在已有上一轮助手消息的前提下注入拒绝事件，断言 `is_error: true`、`subtype: "error_during_execution"`、`error.message` 为拒绝原因，且没有 `result` 字段；同时覆盖相邻形态：拒绝前本轮已有文本、拒绝发生在后续模型轮次、调用方已判定的错误、以及被拒绝的一轮之后紧跟正常回答的一轮。这些用例改动前为红，改动后为绿。

## 改动前后

改动前被拒绝的一轮输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<上一轮答案>"}`；改动后输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}`，且不含 `result`。这是无头输出的协议行为变化，不涉及 TUI，因此没有界面前后对比。

## 测试环境

macOS 通过；Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器内通过；Windows 未验证，改动不含平台相关代码。

## 风险与范围

记录在构建 result 时清空、并被这次构建消费，不会污染后续回合。拒绝仍然结束回合：单次 `-p` 运行下没有自身输出的拒绝现在以退出码 1 结束、与错误信封一致；本轮已经有文本的拒绝保持成功信封、退出码 0。持久 `--input-format stream-json` 会话丢弃每轮状态、行为不变。max-session-turns 的同类处理仍归 #15358。没有新增 subtype、配置或 SDK 类型变更。单次 `-p` 下这两种拒绝的退出码由 0 变为 1，依赖旧值的脚本需要留意。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15704

</details>

prs.title: fix(daemon): refresh supported commands after skill changes (#10918)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Publishes `available_commands_update` from each ACP session when its SkillManager cache changes, and unregisters that listener when the session is disposed. This replaces the earlier `Cache-Control: no-store` approach, which did not refresh server-side metadata.

## Why it's needed

#10918 reports that editing a file-based Skill updates invocation content but leaves the daemon's supported-command description and argument hint stale. The SkillManager already refreshes its cache after filesystem changes; the missing link was notifying the ACP session and Web Shell from that refreshed cache.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a daemon session with a project Skill, edit its description and argument hint, and confirm the client receives an updated command snapshot after the SkillManager refresh. Closing the session must remove the listener.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The regression creates a real temporary `SKILL.md`, loads it through the real SkillManager cache and SkillCommandLoader, changes its metadata, refreshes the cache, and verifies the ACP update contains the new description and hint. It also verifies that a disposed session receives no later update.

Local validation: the session suite passes (26 files, 1988 tests), including the focused regression, and tsc, ESLint and prettier pass.

### Tested on

macOS with Node.js 24.19.0.

## Risk & Scope

The net diff is limited to ACP session listener lifecycle and one regression test. It does not force per-request Skill scans or change route caching, trust boundaries, or command payload shape.

## Linked Issues

Closes #10918

prs.title: chore(types): compile cleanly under the TypeScript 7 native compiler
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes every typecheck project compile cleanly under the TypeScript 7 native compiler (tsgo, `@typescript/native-preview`) while keeping the current tsc 5.8 build byte-for-byte equivalent. On main, tsgo reports 48 errors across the typecheck projects; with this PR it reports none, and tsc still reports none.

The changes fall into five groups:

- **Removed compiler options.** TypeScript 7 drops `baseUrl`. Five projects set it, but every path mapping they declare is already relative to its own config, so removing it changes no module resolution (the esbuild bundle resolves the identical set of inputs).
- **Root directory no longer inferred.** TypeScript 7 defaults the root directory to the config's own folder. The web-shell declaration build and the TypeScript SDK now state the root that tsc 5.8 already inferred, so the emitted declaration layout is unchanged.
- **Automatic `@types` inclusion is gone.** The CUA driver SDK now lists Node types explicitly.
- **`ArrayBuffer` vs `ArrayBufferLike`.** The newer ES2024 library no longer treats `ArrayBufferLike` as an `ArrayBuffer`, so Node `Buffer`s with the default type parameter stopped fitting `fetch`, `Blob` and `Response` bodies. Values produced by Node's buffer factories are now typed as the `ArrayBuffer`-backed buffers they actually are; local accumulators that later receive stream chunks are widened to `Buffer`. The two places that forward caller- or interface-supplied bytes to `fetch` assert `BodyInit`, matching the existing XMLHttpRequest upload path in the same SDK class, so no public signature changes.
- **Checker strictness.** Three redundant `?? []` / `?? undefined` operands that the newer checker flags as unreachable are removed, and the two integrations that import stylesheets declare `*.css` modules now that side-effect imports are checked. The web-shell declaration build config also includes its client `*.d.ts` files, which had been left out of the program by its narrow `include`.

## Why it's needed

Part of the CI speed-up work: tsgo type-checks core and cli roughly 6–8× faster than tsc locally, and the build's tsc chain is on the critical path of every PR that touches those packages. Before a tsgo typecheck lane or a compiler switch can be evaluated, the tree has to compile under it. This PR is that prerequisite and nothing more: the build, the typecheck scripts and CI keep using tsc 5.8.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `npm run build && npm run typecheck` pass with zero errors, as before.
- With the native preview installed anywhere (`npm i @typescript/native-preview`), running `tsgo -p <tsconfig> --noEmit` on each typecheck project reports zero errors; on main it reports 48 (8 projects stop at the removed `baseUrl` option before reaching their real type errors).
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit` (and the same with `tsc`) reports zero errors; before the `include` fix this config masked 227 tsgo errors behind the removed `baseUrl`.
- Emit is unchanged in substance: across 18,652 built files, the only differences are source maps (shifted lines), the four channel declaration files that now carry the narrower buffer type, and web-shell / VS Code webview chunks whose content hashes cascade from the two web-shell source edits. Transpiling each changed source before and after shows identical JavaScript for 16 of 19 files; the other 3 differ only by the removed no-op operands (esbuild re-folds the one `{ body: body }` back to shorthand).
- Swapping only the tsconfigs (same sources), the cli bundle resolves the same 6,385 inputs and produces the same 736 outputs at identical byte sizes (6,383 / 735 when the two `wasm-binary:` virtual inputs are excluded). With the full PR applied, the input set still matches; the removed no-op `?? []` makes one chunk 4 bytes smaller, and content-hashed chunk names change accordingly.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. Verification report:

![TypeScript 7 readiness verification](https://pic.sorrycc.com/1793972773664-919870594.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ (CI)   |

### Environment (optional)

Local: macOS, Node 22.23 and 26.5, tsc 5.8.3, `@typescript/native-preview` 7.0.0-dev.20260707.2. Unit tests for every touched source file (1,495 tests across core, cli, web-shell, the TypeScript SDK and three channel packages) and the 126 script tests that read these tsconfigs all pass.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: two exported DingTalk types and two Weixin helpers now declare `Buffer<ArrayBuffer>` instead of `Buffer`. Every in-repo producer already returns that type and tsc accepts all callers; an out-of-tree caller passing a generic `Buffer` would need the same annotation.
- Not validated / out of scope: switching the build or CI to tsgo, adding a tsgo lane, and tsgo's declaration emit (it orders unions and quotes literals differently, which matters only if tsgo ever emits). The live-host package is not in the workspace install and fails typecheck locally under both compilers, so it was not assessed. Configs outside the typecheck gate also keep their existing tsgo errors: two web-templates CSS imports and the mobile MCP package's removed module-resolution mode. They are left for the follow-up that adds a tsgo lane.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for runtime behavior.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to the CI critical-path work in #16450.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让所有 typecheck 项目在 TypeScript 7 原生编译器（tsgo，`@typescript/native-preview`）下通过类型检查，同时保证现有 tsc 5.8 的构建产物不变。在 main 上，tsgo 对各 typecheck 项目报 48 个错误；合入本 PR 后为 0，tsc 仍为 0。

改动分五类：

- **被移除的编译选项。** TypeScript 7 删掉了 `baseUrl`。有五个项目设置了它，但它们声明的路径映射本来就都是相对于各自配置文件的，所以删除后模块解析不变（esbuild 打包解析到的输入完全相同）。
- **不再推断根目录。** TypeScript 7 默认把根目录设为配置文件所在目录。web-shell 的声明文件构建和 TypeScript SDK 现在显式写出了 tsc 5.8 原本推断出的根目录，生成的声明文件目录结构不变。
- **不再自动引入 `@types`。** CUA driver SDK 现在显式声明 Node 类型。
- **`ArrayBuffer` 与 `ArrayBufferLike`。** 新的 ES2024 lib 不再把 `ArrayBufferLike` 当作 `ArrayBuffer`，于是默认类型参数的 Node `Buffer` 不能再传给 `fetch`、`Blob`、`Response`。由 Node buffer 工厂函数创建的值，现在标注为它们实际的 `ArrayBuffer` 背书类型；之后会接收流数据块的局部变量放宽为 `Buffer`。有两处会把调用方或接口传入的字节转发给 `fetch`，这两处断言为 `BodyInit`，与同一个 SDK 类里已有的 XMLHttpRequest 上传写法一致，因此没有改动任何公开签名。
- **检查器更严格。** 删除了三处被新检查器判定为不可达的多余 `?? []` / `?? undefined`；两个导入样式表的 integration 声明了 `*.css` 模块，因为副作用导入现在也会被检查。web-shell 的声明构建配置也补上了对 client `*.d.ts` 的 include —— 此前它过窄的 `include` 把这些声明文件排除在了 program 之外。

## 为什么需要

这是 CI 提速工作的一部分：在本地，tsgo 对 core 和 cli 的类型检查比 tsc 快约 6–8 倍，而构建中的 tsc 链位于每个改动这些包的 PR 的关键路径上。要评估 tsgo 类型检查 lane 或切换编译器，代码树必须先能在它下面编译通过。本 PR 只做这个前提：构建、typecheck 脚本和 CI 仍然使用 tsc 5.8。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `npm run build && npm run typecheck` 和以前一样零错误通过。
- 在任意位置安装原生预览版（`npm i @typescript/native-preview`），对每个 typecheck 项目运行 `tsgo -p <tsconfig> --noEmit`，结果为零错误；在 main 上为 48 个（其中 8 个项目在遇到被移除的 `baseUrl` 选项时就停止，没有走到真正的类型错误）。
- `cd packages/web-shell && npx tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit`（以及同样参数的 `tsc`）为零错误；在补上 `include` 之前，该配置的 227 个 tsgo 错误被已移除的 `baseUrl` 掩盖。
- 产物实质不变：18,652 个构建文件中，差异只有 source map（行号偏移）、四个现在带有更窄 buffer 类型的 channel 声明文件，以及因两处 web-shell 源码改动而连带变更内容哈希的 web-shell / VS Code webview chunk。逐个转译改动前后的源码，19 个文件中有 16 个生成的 JavaScript 完全相同；另外 3 个的差异仅是删除了无作用的操作数（esbuild 会把其中唯一一处 `{ body: body }` 折回简写）。
- 只替换 tsconfig（源码不变）构建 cli bundle，解析到的 6,385 个输入相同，生成的 736 个输出字节大小也完全相同（排除两个 `wasm-binary:` 虚拟输入后为 6,383 / 735）。应用整个 PR 时，输入集合仍然一致；删除无作用的 `?? []` 让一个 chunk 小了 4 字节，带内容哈希的 chunk 文件名也随之变化。

### 证据（前后对比）

不涉及 UI。验证报告见上方英文部分的截图及下方评论。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️（CI）   |

### 环境（可选）

本地：macOS，Node 22.23 和 26.5，tsc 5.8.3，`@typescript/native-preview` 7.0.0-dev.20260707.2。所有改动源文件对应的单元测试（core、cli、web-shell、TypeScript SDK 和三个 channel 包，共 1,495 个）以及读取这些 tsconfig 的 126 个脚本测试全部通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：两个导出的 DingTalk 类型和两个 Weixin 辅助函数现在声明为 `Buffer<ArrayBuffer>` 而不是 `Buffer`。仓库内所有产生这些值的地方本来就返回这个类型，tsc 接受所有调用方；仓库外如果有调用方传入泛型 `Buffer`，需要加同样的标注。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：把构建或 CI 切换到 tsgo、新增 tsgo lane，以及 tsgo 的声明文件输出（它对联合类型的排序和字面量引号与 tsc 不同，只有在用 tsgo 输出时才有影响）。live-host 包不在 workspace 安装范围内，本地两种编译器下 typecheck 都失败，因此未评估。typecheck 门禁之外的配置也保留了原有的 tsgo 错误：web-templates 的两处 CSS 导入和 mobile MCP 包已被移除的模块解析模式。它们留给新增 tsgo lane 的后续 PR 处理。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：运行时行为无变化。

## 关联 Issue

承接 #16450 的 CI 关键路径工作。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add opt-in personal memory backed by Holo
prs.body:
## What this PR does Adds opt-in personal memory to Managed Agent. Each authenticated tenant and actor owns one idempotently created MemoryStore; Session creation can bind that Store immutably, including across authorized Workspaces. Bound Sessions and children receiving their context require owner access in addition to existing Workspace grants. The control plane owns Holo credentials, namespace selection, entry ownership and durable operation receipts. Hosted recalls bounded, untrusted reference context for new user inputs and exposes search, exact remember, get and content-checked forget through existing tool approval and Plan Mode. Recovery reuses persisted results, and uncertain external writes are never automatically resent or reported as successful. Public API, SDK and WebShell parameter forwarding are synchronized. The feature remains disabled by default. Existing persistence transaction entries stay in place; small same-package responsibility splits keep the new class-size gate intact and tighten its ceilings. ## Why it's needed Managed Sessions currently cannot explicitly reuse personal memory across conversations. Local Mem0 configuration and provider user filters do not establish Managed tenant authorization. An independently owned Store with an immutable Session binding gives users explicit control while preventing private context from leaking through shared Workspace session surfaces or recovery paths. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. With personal memory enabled on an isolated deployment, create a Store twice as the same trusted actor and confirm the same ID is returned. Another actor or tenant must receive a different Store and must not bind the first Store. Omit the binding and confirm zero memory requests and no memory tools. 2. Bind a Session, explicitly ask it to remember synthetic content, and confirm approval is required under the ordinary policy. After approval, another Session owned by the same actor in another authorized Workspace should recall the content. Ordinary conversation must not create memories, and Plan Mode must refuse mutations. 3. Give another actor read or operator access to the Workspace. Private Session lists, details, SSE, history, artifacts, actions and related session resources must remain inaccessible. Children inherit private visibility without Store access, and private messages must not enter shared Sessions. Unbound Sessions retain their current access behavior. 4. Replace the Harness and restart the control plane while memory approval is pending. The Store binding and Action ID must survive, and approval must cause exactly one external write. Lost write replies must replay a saved result or return unknown without resubmission; stale writers and changed arguments under the same key must be rejected. Changed memory content must prevent deletion, and confirmed deletion must suppress stale search hits. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: the baseline public contract has no memory resource or binding, and Hosted declares none of the four personal memory tools. After: a real packaged Node Harness, Spring control plane and MySQL recovery test passed against a local Holo protocol fixture, including pending approval across both process restarts, exactly one write, cross-Workspace recall and zero requests/tools for an unbound Session. Separate live Holo checks passed 11/11 in two disposable namespaces and verified synchronous IDs, authoritative exact-read scope, search isolation and deletion cleanup. No new UI page or TUI layout is introduced. On the current integration, root build, sequential typecheck, bundle, changed-source ESLint/Prettier and configuration-reference generation checks passed. Four completed CLI files passed 302 tests, the focused recovery/memory regression run passed 16 tests with 662 intentionally skipped, and WebShell provider passed 102 tests. The larger six-file CLI run hit a 15-second timeout in an unchanged 64-message budget case and was interrupted; that same case passed in 10.743 seconds with one worker and its original timeout. The failed/interrupted run remains recorded, and isolation does not establish its root cause. Initial fast Java CI executed 6,321 tests with 23 failures: 22 stale contract/fixture mismatches are corrected, while one SSH start-timing failure remains unclassified. New-head Java verification is pending CI; no timeout, selector or gate was weakened. Historical JDK 21 focused runs passed 447 tests and Checkstyle before the main integrations. The separate E2E report records exact revisions, commands, failed attempts and coverage limits. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS 26.7.1 arm64, Node.js 26.12.1, pnpm 11.24.0, Oracle JDK 21.0.8 and Maven 3.9.14. MySQL 8.4.11 used a disposable loopback instance and isolated catalogs; all task-owned processes and database files were cleaned up. Holo protocol checks used synthetic content and disposable namespaces. Initial SDK checks ran on JDK 25; final Managed checks explicitly used JDK 21. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: privacy enforcement spans shared Session surfaces, child context and execution recovery. External writes can have an uncertain outcome; the conservative result is unknown without automatic retry. Enablement requires a dedicated Holo service, server-side credentials and verified cross-service sharing disabled. - Not validated / out of scope: Current-head Java compilation/tests and the full unit/H2, MySQL, Hosted/fault, SpotBugs, coverage and cross-platform CI gates remain pending. The repository selects the fast tier for PR pushes; the first maintainer approval of this head triggers the full Managed gate. The process-recovery test used a local Holo protocol fixture; live Holo was verified separately, and its deployment sharing configuration was not inspected. Team stores, automatic extraction, Dream, directory mounts, memory versioning and a separate management page are out of scope. - Breaking changes / migration notes: the first-release V1 schema baseline changes in place, so existing development catalogs must be recreated. Memory stays disabled by default. Session binding is immutable, deleting a memory affects future retrieval, and existing Session history retention and Workspace file-sharing rules continue to apply. Synchronized design and acceptance criteria: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6082ddb5e9b4a08702e3e9d957abc2e8426be3cb/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-user-memory.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6082ddb5e9b4a08702e3e9d957abc2e8426be3cb/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-user-memory.zh-CN.md). Capability accounting is synchronized in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6082ddb5e9b4a08702e3e9d957abc2e8426be3cb/docs/design/2026-10-21-managed-capability-parity.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6082ddb5e9b4a08702e3e9d957abc2e8426be3cb/docs/design/2026-10-21-managed-capability-parity.zh-CN.md). ## Linked Issues N/A — implements the approved personal-memory design; no linked issue.
中文说明 ## 本 PR 的改动 为 Managed Agent 增加显式启用的个人记忆。每个经过认证的租户与用户拥有一个可幂等创建的 MemoryStore；创建 Session 时可以不可变地绑定该 Store，并在有权访问的多个 Workspace 中复用。绑定后的 Session 及接收其上下文的子 Session，除现有 Workspace 授权外，还必须通过所属用户检查。 Control Plane 负责 Holo 凭据、namespace 选择、条目归属和持久化操作 receipt。Hosted 为新用户输入召回有界的非可信参考上下文，并通过现有工具审批和 Plan Mode 提供搜索、准确保存、读取及完整内容核对后的删除。恢复复用已持久化结果，不确定的外部写入不会自动重发或被报告为成功。公开 API、SDK 和 WebShell 参数透传同步更新，功能保持默认关闭。持久化事务入口保留原位，通过同包的小型职责拆分遵守新增类大小门禁，并向下收紧其上限。 ## 为什么需要 Managed Session 当前无法显式跨会话复用个人记忆。本地 Mem0 配置和 provider 用户过滤条件不能替代 Managed 多租鉴权。由用户独立拥有的 Store 与不可变 Session 绑定提供明确控制，并防止私有上下文通过共享 Workspace 的会话入口或恢复链路泄漏。 ## 评审者测试计划 ### 验证方式 1. 在隔离部署中启用个人记忆，以同一可信用户创建两次 Store，确认返回同一 ID。其他用户或租户应获得不同 Store，并且不能绑定第一个 Store。省略绑定时，确认没有记忆请求或记忆工具。 2. 绑定 Session，明确要求记住合成内容，确认普通审批策略要求授权。授权后，同一用户在另一个有权访问的 Workspace 创建的 Session 应能召回该内容。普通对话不能产生记忆，Plan Mode 必须拒绝修改。 3. 为另一个用户授予 Workspace 读或操作权限，确认个人 Session 的列表、详情、SSE、历史、产物、Action 及相关会话资源仍不可访问。子 Session 继承私有可见性，但不获得 Store 访问权；私有消息不能进入共享 Session。未绑定的 Session 保持现有访问行为。 4. 在记忆审批等待期间替换 Harness 并重启 Control Plane，确认 Store 绑定和 Action ID 保留，审批后只发生一次外部写入。写入响应丢失时，应重放已保存结果或返回 unknown，不能重新提交；拒绝旧 writer，以及同 key 不同参数。记忆内容变化时必须拒绝删除，确认删除后必须屏蔽残留搜索命中。 ### 变更前后证据 变更前：基线公开协议没有记忆资源或绑定，Hosted 不声明四个个人记忆工具。变更后：真实打包 Node Harness、Spring Control Plane 与 MySQL 的恢复测试通过，Holo 使用本地协议 fixture；覆盖两个进程重启后保留审批、只写入一次、跨 Workspace 召回，以及未绑定 Session 零请求和零工具。独立的真实 Holo 检查在两个临时 namespace 中通过 11/11，验证同步 ID、精确读取的权威 scope、搜索隔离及删除清理。本次不新增 UI 页面或 TUI 布局。 当前整合版本的根 build、顺序 typecheck、bundle、修改源文件的 ESLint/Prettier 和配置参考生成检查通过。四个完整 CLI 文件共 302 项测试通过，恢复/记忆定向回归 16 项通过、662 项有意跳过，WebShell provider 102 项通过。较大的六文件 CLI 运行在未修改的 64 条消息预算用例中触发 15 秒超时后中止；该用例随后以单 worker、原超时限制在 10.743 秒内通过。失败与中止记录继续保留，隔离通过不能确定其根因。初次 fast Java CI 执行 6,321 项测试、23 项失败，其中 22 项旧契约/fixture 不匹配已修正，一项 SSH 启动时序失败仍未归因。新 head 的 Java 验证待 CI，未放宽超时、选择器或门禁。历史 JDK 21 定向运行在整合 main 之前通过 447 项测试及 Checkstyle。独立 E2E 报告记录准确版本、命令、失败尝试和覆盖限制。 ### 已测试平台 | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 环境（可选） macOS 26.7.1 arm64、Node.js 26.12.1、pnpm 11.24.0、Oracle JDK 21.0.8 和 Maven 3.9.14。MySQL 8.4.11 使用临时 loopback 实例和隔离 catalog；任务创建的进程和数据库文件均已清理。Holo 协议检查使用合成内容及临时 namespace。初期 SDK 检查在 JDK 25 上运行，最终 Managed 检查显式使用 JDK 21。 ## prs.title: fix(vscode): localize Companion command titles and ship NLS catalogs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Localizes the Companion command titles that were still hardcoded English (nine at the original base, plus `qwen-code.logout` and `qwen-code.upgrade` that `main` added later) using VS Code's existing English and Simplified Chinese catalogs, and includes both catalogs in the extension package. All fourteen resolved English command titles, command IDs, menus, keybindings and settings remain unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Nine command titles remain English under a Chinese VS Code display language. In addition, the packaging whitelist excludes both existing catalogs: the installed vsce 3.9.2 file list contains neither before this change. Adding translations alone would therefore leave the installed extension untranslated.

This is the manifest-command slice invited by the maintainer in #13967. It leaves notifications, configuration descriptions, additional locales, webview language precedence and shared CLI translation sources for follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With a Simplified Chinese VS Code display language, command titles such as Open, Focus Chat View and New Conversation should resolve to Chinese. With English, the titles should remain exactly as before. Command execution, keybindings and menu visibility should remain unchanged. Confirm that both translation catalogs are present in the packaged VSIX.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: nine titles are hardcoded English; neither NLS catalog appears in `vsce ls --no-dependencies`.
- After: all fourteen titles resolve in English and Simplified Chinese; both catalogs are listed and included byte-for-byte in a real vsce-generated VSIX.
- Before/after Command Palette screenshots below use an isolated manifest fixture in real VS Code with no-op activation; they do not show full Companion runtime verification.

| Before (zh-CN) | After (zh-CN) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/verification/issue-13967/before-zh.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/23e40b10d9ef994a5386a2ac194157a3f4b04319/docs/verification/issue-13967/after-zh.png) |

- Actual VS Code 1.142.0 isolated extension-host tests confirm the before/after Chinese labels and unchanged English labels. These tests use copied real manifests/catalogs and a no-op activation stub: they exercise VS Code's own NLS loader, not full Companion activation or command execution.
- Five focused manifest/package-selection tests pass. Isolated mutations confirm that removing the catalog inclusion, cross-wiring a command title key, and changing a baseline English label each fail the strengthened checks; all three passed the previous tests. Root build, repository typecheck, bundle, companion build/typecheck/lint, formatting and whitespace checks pass. The complete repository test suite was not run.
- After merging current `main` (`4cea3a792f`), the two titles it added are converted too (`e7cfc18d4a`). On that tree the five focused tests pass, all fourteen titles resolve in both catalogs with none left English under zh-CN, the companion suite passes (48 files, 773 passed, 1 skipped), and `tsc --noEmit` and eslint report no errors.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ build, types, packaging and isolated VS Code NLS loader |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment

macOS arm64, Node 26.8.2, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, vsce 3.9.2, VS Code 1.142.0. The verification VSIX contains the built extension and webview but is not a full release package with the separately prepared bundled CLI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: missing or mismatched NLS keys; manifest tests, actual VS Code loading and archive inspection cover this path.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete extension activation, command execution, full release installation and other operating systems.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; English fallback titles are preserved.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/blob/e7cfc18d4afdf3827b59766a25d8d21f7f872afb/docs/design/2026-10-17-companion-command-localization.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/Sumire-no-kai/qwen-code/blob/e7cfc18d4afdf3827b59766a25d8d21f7f872afb/docs/design/2026-10-17-companion-command-localization.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13967. This completes only the manifest command-title slice, not the entire localization request.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

使用 VS Code 现有的英文与简体中文语言文件，本地化仍硬编码英文的 Companion 命令标题（原基线上的九个，以及 `main` 之后新增的 `qwen-code.logout` 和 `qwen-code.upgrade`），并将两个语言文件包含在扩展安装包中。十四个命令解析后的英文标题、命令 ID、菜单、快捷键和设置均保持不变。

## 修改原因

中文 VS Code 显示语言下，九个命令标题仍显示英文。此外，当前打包白名单排除了两个现有语言文件：修改前，已安装的 vsce 3.9.2 文件列表中没有这两个文件。因此只添加翻译仍无法让安装后的扩展获得本地化。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在简体中文显示语言的 VS Code 中，打开、聚焦聊天视图、新建对话等命令标题应解析为中文。英文显示语言下，标题应与之前完全一致。命令执行、快捷键和菜单可见性应保持不变。确认打包后的 VSIX 包含两个翻译文件。

### 修改前后证据

- 修改前：九个标题硬编码英文，`vsce ls --no-dependencies` 不包含任何 NLS 文件。
- 修改后：十四个标题均可解析为英文与简体中文；文件列表包含两个语言文件，实际由 vsce 生成的 VSIX 中两个文件与源码逐字节相同。
- 以下 Command Palette 修改前后截图来自真实 VS Code 中的隔离清单测试环境，使用空激活模块，不代表完整 Companion 运行时验证。

- 实际 VS Code 1.142.0 隔离扩展宿主测试确认了中文标题的前后变化和英文标题不变。测试使用真实清单及语言文件的副本，并以空激活模块隔离运行：验证的是 VS Code 自身的 NLS 加载器，而非完整 Companion 激活或命令执行。
- 五个定向清单/打包文件选择测试通过。隔离变异验证确认：删除语言文件放行规则、接错命令标题键、修改英文基线标题都会使加强后的测试失败；这三类错误在此前测试中均能通过。根构建、仓库类型检查、bundle、Companion 构建/类型检查/lint、格式和空白检查均通过。未执行完整仓库测试套件。
- 合并当前 `main`（`4cea3a792f`）后，其新增的两个标题也已改为语言文件引用（`e7cfc18d4a`）。在该代码上：五个定向测试通过；十四个标题均可在两个语言文件中解析，中文环境下没有残留英文；Companion 全量测试通过（48 个文件，773 个通过、1 个跳过）；`tsc --noEmit` 和 eslint 无错误。

### 测试平台

### 环境

macOS arm64，Node 26.8.2，仓库锁定 pnpm 11.24.0，vsce 3.9.2，VS Code 1.142.0。验证 VSIX 包含构建后的扩展和 Webview，但不是包含单独准备的内置 CLI 的完整发行包。

- 主要风险：NLS 键缺失或不匹配；清单测试、实际 VS Code 加载和压缩包检查覆盖了该路径。

prs.title: feat(channels): deliver injected messages into the running turn
prs.body:
Fixes #15630

Adds a fourth dispatch mode, `inject`, which delivers a message into the session's **running** turn instead of chaining a new turn behind it, so the agent sees it before it finishes.

## What changed

- `packages/channels/base/src/types.ts` — `DispatchMode` gains `inject`; new `ChannelMidTurnDeliveryResult`.
- `packages/channels/base/src/ChannelAgentBridge.ts` — optional `enqueueMidTurnMessage(sessionId, message, signal)`. Optional so the ten bundled adapters and third-party plugins keep compiling.
- `packages/channels/base/src/DaemonChannelBridge.ts` — passes the capability through to the `DaemonChannelSessionClient` it already holds. `DaemonSessionClient.enqueueMidTurnMessage` already exists in the SDK, so no new queue or drain is introduced on this path, as triage recommended.
- `packages/channels/base/src/ChannelBase.ts` — `case 'inject'` in the in-flight dispatch switch. It uses the same `isAuthorizedForSharedSession` gate as `steer`, so a non-operator of a shared session cannot post into another operator's live turn; a refused inject falls through to normal queuing. When the bridge lacks the capability, the call throws, or the daemon answers `accepted: false` (turn already idle), the message is chained as an ordinary turn instead of being dropped.
- `packages/cli/src/serve/channel-settings-store.ts` — `inject` accepted for the channel-level and per-group `dispatchMode` settings.

## Verification

- `packages/channels/base` full suite: 26 files, 1754 tests pass, including 5 new `inject` mode cases in `ChannelBase.test.ts` (delivered mid-turn with no second prompt; chains when the session went idle; chains when the bridge cannot reach a turn; chains when delivery throws; denials for unauthorized shared-session members) and 3 new pass-through cases in `DaemonChannelBridge.test.ts`.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean for `packages/channels/base`.
- `npx eslint` and `prettier --check` clean on the changed files.
- CLI: only the touched `channel-settings-store` test was run (`-t "accepts env-resolvable descriptor fields and typed shared fields"`, passing). The full CLI test file has 31 pre-existing failures in this checkout because it loads channel plugins (`@qwen-code/channel-dingtalk`, etc.) that are not installed in the shared `node_modules`; those failures are unrelated to this change. `tsc -p packages/cli` cannot be run cleanly here either (unbuilt sibling workspace packages), and I confirmed it reports no errors in any touched file.
- **Not run:** full `npm run build`; no live channel deployment was exercised, so actual mid-turn delivery against a running model turn is unverified end to end.

## Out of scope

The standalone `qwen channel start` (`AcpBridge`) queue and its own `craft/drainMidTurnQueue` handler — triage's piece 2 — are a separate follow-up.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): honor configured loading phrases
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Applies configured custom loading phrases in the Web Shell while preserving an embedding host's explicit phrase customization and the built-in fallback. The custom phrase list is available to the browser from workspace settings, but its unsupported array editor stays hidden.

The latest main already honors loading-phrase visibility through #15337. This PR keeps that behavior and its browser-side live-update handling. It also preserves the shared terminal schema's restart requirement and adds a regression using the real schema and restart-selection helpers.

## Why it's needed

#14324 reports both visibility and customization being ignored in the browser. Main now covers visibility; configured custom phrases remain the part addressed here. During maintenance, the branch's shared restart flag was also found to disagree with terminal behavior: the terminal reads an accessibility snapshot taken at startup, so removing the restart requirement silently loses its restart prompt. The flag is restored while keeping the browser's existing live-update exception.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm that configured non-empty phrase strings reach the browser status indicator, invalid entries fall back to built-ins, equal settings reloads keep the customization context stable, and an explicit embedding host callback takes precedence. Confirm that disabling visibility still suppresses phrases. For the restart contract, terminal settings must classify this key as requiring restart, while the Web Shell must avoid a redundant restart banner for the same live setting.

### How to verify

Use the focused CLI schema/helper and workspace-settings suites, the Web Shell settings/status/panel suites, and the loading-phrase App cases. Inspect actual passed/skipped counts. The real-source restart probe must return `true` and include `ui.accessibility.enableLoadingPhrases` in the restart-required list. Inspect the merged App tree to confirm it retains both the effective customization provider and main's MCP App visibility provider.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before maintenance, at PR head `9f42a6c1`, the real source returned `schemaFlag=false`, `requiresRestart=false`, and an empty restart-required list. Existing schema/helper tests still passed because they did not pin this real key's restart contract.
- The added regression failed with `expected false to be true` before the flag repair and passed after it. The new test imports the actual schema and helpers rather than mocking them.
- 2026-10-30 verification: 309 passed. The App selection executed 9 cases; 1,357 App cases were excluded by selection (reported as skipped). The CLI suites passed 198 cases and the Web Shell selection passed 102, including the additional matched voice-settings suite. No full App suite is claimed. The same six phrase cases against current-main App source had 1 failure and 5 passes: configured phrases were undefined rather than the expected list. After restoring the patch, all six plus three host-visibility controls passed. Full workspace build, full workspace/integration typecheck, targeted ESLint and Prettier all passed.
- Prior browser A/B evidence is available in [the existing round-2 verification](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14353#issuecomment-6214730656). That evidence belongs to the earlier head and its author; this maintenance did not rerun that browser session or capture fresh screenshots.

### Maintenance validation (2026-11-02)

Merged main at 8aea64d5 to incorporate the current lint/CI gate without changing this PR's focused 10-file diff. The full workspace build, targeted ESLint/Prettier, and the nine lint-freshness helper tests passed on Windows. The focused suites passed 309 tests: CLI 198, Web Shell 102, and App 9; 1,381 App cases were excluded by selection. The real-source restart probe again returned true and selected this key. The red/green experiments and full workspace/integration typecheck described in the dated October 30 evidence were not repeated today. No new browser A/B, interactive TUI, live model, or Java fast-tier validation is claimed. The previous Java CI run contains heap exhaustion and test errors; the new remote CI result remains pending publication and execution.
### Tested on

| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | Not tested in this maintenance |
| Windows | 309 focused tests passed; 1,381 App cases excluded by selection; source probe and red/green regression passed |
| Linux | Not tested in this maintenance |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node 24.20.0, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Local source/contract and component verification; no live model call or new browser/TUI session is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: custom phrases are configured through the existing configuration keys; the settings panel does not gain an unsupported array editor.
- Not validated / out of scope: fresh real-browser A/B and Linux/macOS interactive sessions. Suggestion-level documentation and descriptor-coverage follow-ups from earlier rounds remain deferred under the repository's convergence policy.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The shared terminal restart contract is preserved; browser live settings continue using their existing exception.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14324. Visibility is already present in main through #15337; this PR completes the configured-phrase path.

prs.title: docs(core): design the idle-time auto-compaction pass
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the bilingual design document for idle-time auto-compaction (issue #16508): run the existing chat compression while the user is away instead of only at the in-turn threshold. The document fixes the reviewable contract — dual-condition trigger (idle duration + soft watermark sharing the in-turn accounting), a new `idle` `PreCompactTrigger` kind riding the existing manual-pass machinery, concurrent-prompt wait semantics, headless/hosted exclusions, and acceptance criteria — before any implementation.

Docs-only change; no production or test code.

## Why it's needed

Today's auto-compaction fires inside the send path (llm-chat.ts:3537/:6531), so the summarizer's 30–60 s lands mid-turn, and sessions run near the ceiling before it fires. The proposal moves that work to idle time. A design-first PR keeps the implementation slice reviewable against a fixed contract and lets the defaults (idle minutes, watermark) be calibrated with maintainer input before code lands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Documentation only — check both language versions carry matching structure (Why / Design / Non-goals / Acceptance criteria / Open questions), reciprocal language links below both titles, and that the code anchors it cites exist as named (llm-chat.ts:3537/:6531, PreCompactTrigger, use-program-status idle state).

## Risk & Scope

- Docs-only; no behavior change, no CI lanes beyond the docs profile.
- Non-goals recorded in both versions: no algorithm change, no provider cache pinning, no hosted surface in this slice.

## Linked Issues

Proposal: #16508.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show tool arguments and result in expanded cards
prs.body:
## What this PR does Expanding a tool card in the Web Shell transcript now shows the call itself — its arguments and its result — for every tool that has no built-in detail view, instead of repeating the same one-line result summary that the collapsed row already shows. A JSON object or array is pretty-printed and syntax-highlighted; anything else is shown as recorded. Long payloads keep a visible truncation marker and a Show more action that raises the inline cap from 4,000 to 40,000 characters, matching the trajectory inspector. The call description stays in the collapsed row, so arguments are not shown twice, and plain-text results keep their clickable session links. ## Why it's needed The chevron on these rows promised details the expanded state never delivered: MCP calls, the `tool_call` bridge, `list_directory`, `grep`, `web_fetch` and the rest expanded to the same 80-character summary. The full payload was already available in the per-turn "Tool calls" panel and the trajectory inspector, but not in the conversation, so users had to leave the transcript to read what a tool actually returned. This closes #15280 with the first-PR shape the triage comment proposed: reuse the existing detail primitive, keep the allowlist untouched, and leave configurable caps and managed-session details to follow-ups. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Build and serve this branch locally: `npm run build && npm run bundle`, then `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port --no-open`, and open the printed URL. 2. In a session, trigger a tool outside the built-in detail renderers: ask for a directory listing, a `grep_search`, or an MCP tool such as `mcp__github__pull_request_read` (use `tool_search` first if it is deferred). 3. Expand the row. Expect two labelled blocks, Arguments and Result. A compact JSON payload should render as an indented, highlighted code block; a plain-text payload should stay preformatted. 4. Collapse the row: the one-line summary should be unchanged, and the expanded header should not repeat the call description. 5. For a payload above 4,000 characters, expect a truncation marker and Show more; clicking it should reveal up to 40,000 characters. 6. Confirm read, edit/write, shell, skill, advisor, ask_user_question, workflow, sub-agent and MCP App cards render exactly as before. ### Evidence (Before & After) Captured on Windows in the locally served Web Shell. Each pair shows the expanded card before the change on the left — still the same one-line summary — and the expanded card after the change on the right, with Arguments and Result; the same card renders in the desktop client and in a browser-attached Web Shell. #### MCP tool | Before | After | | :----: | :---: | | | | #### Grep tool | Before | After | | :----: | :---: | | | | #### ToolSearch | Before | After | | :----: | :---: | | | | Unit tests: 232 in `ToolGroup` / `toolFormatting` / `SubAgentPanel`, 109 in `TurnCallsPanel` / `TrajectoryDetail`; typecheck, ESLint, Prettier and the web-shell build pass. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | ### Environment (optional) `npm run build && npm run bundle`, then `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port 64617 --no-open`; Web Shell opened in the browser. Unit tests run per package with vitest. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: every tool outside the built-in allowlist now renders its full payload inline when expanded. Formatting a payload costs a one-time parse and re-serialization on expansion — measured at about 0.5 ms for 100 KB, 2 ms for 500 KB and 6.7 ms for 2 MB on the author's machine; the display itself stays capped at 4,000/40,000 characters. - Not validated / out of scope: managed (hosted) sessions lazy-load details only for read and shell, so MCP details there remain unavailable; MCP App cards keep their dedicated interactive renderer; a configurable cap is a maintainer decision. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Collapsed rows, the Tool Calls panel, the trajectory inspector and the CLI TUI are unchanged. ### Follow-up: the `tool_search` envelope `tool_search` results still render as the model-facing `…` envelope, which is why the ToolSearch screenshot shows formatted arguments but a plain-text result. The wrapper is produced only by `tool_search`, and each `` payload is valid JSON once the tag-character escapes are decoded, so a dedicated renderer can list the matched tools with their names, descriptions and pretty-printed schemas while keeping the trailing "Not found" and code-mode notes as text. This is deliberately outside this PR: the envelope is a model-facing contract that core parses for tool reveals and goal provenance, so changing it here would widen the blast radius for no display gain. It will be tracked as a separate follow-up. ## Linked Issues Fixes #15280
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 在 Web Shell 的会话记录中，展开工具卡片时现在会显示该调用本身——参数和结果——适用于所有没有内置详情视图的工具，而不是重复折叠行里已经出现的一行结果摘要。JSON 对象或数组会被格式化并做语法高亮；其他内容按原样显示。长内容保留截断提示和「Show more」按钮，点击后把内联上限从 4,000 字符提高到 40,000 字符，与轨迹检查器一致。调用描述只保留在折叠行中，避免参数重复出现；纯文本结果中的会话链接仍然可点击。 ## 为什么需要 这些行的展开箭头承诺了展开后并不存在的细节：MCP 调用、`tool_call` 桥、`list_directory`、`grep`、`web_fetch` 等展开后仍然只是同一条 80 字符摘要。完整 payload 早已存在于每轮的「Tool calls」面板和轨迹检查器中，但对话里看不到，用户必须离开会话记录才能读到工具实际返回的内容。本 PR 按 triage 评论建议的首版形态关闭 #15280：复用已有的详情组件，不改白名单，可配置上限与 managed 会话详情留作后续。 ## 审查测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 在本地构建并启动本分支：`npm run build && npm run bundle`，然后 `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port <空闲端口> --no-open`，打开输出的 URL。 2. 在会话中触发一个不在内置详情渲染器里的工具：目录列表、`grep_search`，或 MCP 工具（如 `mcp__github__pull_request_read`；若被延迟，先用 `tool_search`）。 3. 展开该行。应看到两个带标题的区块：Arguments 与 Result。紧凑 JSON 应渲染为缩进并高亮的代码块；纯文本 payload 保持预格式文本。 4. 折叠该行：一行摘要保持不变，展开后的头部不重复调用描述。 5. 对于超过 4,000 字符的 payload，应出现截断提示和 Show more；点击后最多显示 40,000 字符。 6. 确认 read、edit/write、shell、skill、advisor、ask_user_question、workflow、子代理和 MCP App 卡片与之前完全一致。 ### 证据（前后对比） 在 Windows 上于本地启动的 Web Shell 中截取。每组左侧为改动前的展开卡片（仍然只有一行摘要），右侧为改动后的展开卡片（Arguments 与 Result）；desktop 客户端与浏览器接入的 Web Shell 渲染结果一致。 #### MCP 工具 | 之前 | 之后 | | :--: | :--: | | | | #### Grep 工具 | 之前 | 之后 | | :--: | :--: | | | | #### ToolSearch | 之前 | 之后 | | :--: | :--: | | | | 单元测试：`ToolGroup` / `toolFormatting` / `SubAgentPanel` 共 232 个，`TurnCallsPanel` / `TrajectoryDetail` 共 109 个；typecheck、ESLint、Prettier 和 web-shell 构建均通过。 ### 测试平台 | 操作系统 | 状态 | | :------: | :--: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ✅ | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ | ### 环境（可选） `npm run build && npm run bundle`，然后 `node dist/cli.js serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --workspace --port 64617 --no-open`；在浏览器中打开 Web Shell。单元测试按包用 vitest 运行。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险/取舍：所有不在内置白名单里的工具展开后都会内联渲染完整 payload。展开时格式化需要一次解析和重新序列化——在作者机器上实测约 0.5 ms（100 KB）、2 ms（500 KB）、6.7 ms（2 MB）；显示本身仍限制在 4,000/40,000 字符。 - 未验证/不在范围内：managed（托管）会话只对 read 和 shell 懒加载详情，因此其中的 MCP 详情仍不可用；MCP App 卡片保留专用的交互式渲染器；可配置上限由 maintainer 决定。 - 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。折叠行、Tool Calls 面板、轨迹检查器和 CLI TUI 均未改变。 ### 后续工作：`tool_search` 外层包装 `tool_search` 的结果仍然以模型可读的 `…` 外层形式渲染，因此上图中参数已格式化，而结果仍是纯文本。该外层只由 `tool_search` 产生；每个 `` payload 在解码标签转义后都是合法 JSON，因此可以做一个专用渲染器，列出匹配的工具名、描述和格式化后的 schema，同时把结尾的 "Not found" 与 code-mode 提示保留为文本。这被有意排除在本 PR 之外：该外层是模型侧契约，core 会解析它（工具 reveal 与 goal provenance），在这里改动会扩大影响面却没有显示收益。将作为独立的后续工作跟踪。 ## 关联 Issue Fixes #15280

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and retention-only handling of an oversized direct text resource (the prompt is admitted, the resource reaches the model live, and the durable record drops it with `embeddedResourcesTruncated` set). Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and the oversized-resource retention-only drop. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are admitted and delivered to the model live; only their durable retention is dropped, marked with `embeddedResourcesTruncated` — the prompt always runs. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. The new text-resource replay limit bounds durable retention only; it does not reject prompts or change their parameters.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): share session view reset state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR consolidates the shared transcript-view reset used by session changes and `/clear`. It also makes the component contract explicit: when a consumer keeps the same transcript component mounted across a session-key change, a reading pause from the previous session is cleared. A reconnect within the same session continues to preserve that pause.

## Why it's needed

The two reset paths maintained overlapping state independently. Sharing their common reset keeps those paths consistent and covers the component's mount-stable session-switch contract. The shipped routes already remount the transcript or render an empty transcript when switching sessions, so this is component-level hardening, not a demonstrated user-visible fix on those routes.

The main-CI failure tracked in #15038 is an unhandled rejection in the hosted workspace tool-turn tests. This Web Shell change does not fix that failure and must not close its tracker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Keep one transcript component mounted, pause following, and change its session key while supplying the next session's non-empty transcript. Following should resume, both with and without a replay transition.
- Reconnect within the same session after pausing. The reading position should remain paused.
- Clear the transcript within the same session. The existing clear/reset behavior should remain intact.
- Treat the session-switch DOM cases as component-contract coverage; the shipped routes' remount/empty-first behavior is not a before/after reproduction of this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Earlier review reports establish that the added DOM cases fail without the session-switch pause reset and pass with it. The same reports establish that shipped-route-shaped cases already pass on the base. Those historical results support the component contract only; they are not new validation of the current head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Windows | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Linux | Earlier DOM evidence is recorded in the PR discussion; the previous head's smoke check failed and checks for this closeout are pending |

## Risk & Scope

- The shared reset clears reading-pause, pagination-snapshot and expansion state. Each caller retains its additional resets; the settled-stale latch is cleared by `/clear`, not by the render-phase session switch.
- This PR changes no shipped route's mounting or empty-transcript behavior and does not repair the hosted workspace tool-turn failure.
- No local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run during this closeout, as requested. The previous smoke failure is reported separately and checks for the new head are pending; no passing browser result is claimed.
- No public API or migration change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15038; this PR does not resolve it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

合并会话切换与 `/clear` 共用的视图重置逻辑，并明确组件契约：调用方若在切换 session key 时保留同一个消息列表实例，上一会话的阅读暂停状态会被清除。同一会话重连仍保留阅读暂停。

## 为什么需要

两条路径原先分别维护重叠的重置状态。共用重置逻辑可以保持行为一致，并补全不重建组件时的会话切换契约。当前已发布页面在切换会话时会重建消息列表，或先渲染空记录，因此本 PR 是组件层加固，不是已证实的现有页面可见缺陷修复。

#15038 跟踪的是 hosted workspace tool-turn 测试中的未处理拒绝。该 Web Shell 改动不能修复此 CI 故障，也不应自动关闭它。

## Reviewer 测试计划

- 保持消息列表实例不变，暂停跟随后，改变 session key 并传入下一会话的非空记录。有回放与无回放两种情况下都应恢复跟随。
- 同一会话暂停后重连，应继续保持阅读位置。
- 在同一会话清空记录，原有清空和重置行为应保持。
- 新增 DOM 用例验证组件契约；已发布页面重建组件或先清空记录的路径不能作为本改动的前后对照复现。

## 已有证据与验证边界

此前评审记录表明，移除会话切换时的暂停重置会使新增 DOM 用例失败，保留时通过；按已发布页面形态编写的对照用例在 base 上原本就通过。这些历史结果只支撑组件契约，不代表本轮重新验证了当前 head。

## 风险与范围

公共重置处理阅读暂停、分页快照和展开状态；调用方保留各自额外的重置。settled-stale 状态只在 `/clear` 路径清除，不在渲染期会话切换路径清除。本 PR 不改变页面挂载方式，也不修复 hosted workspace tool-turn 故障。无公共 API 或迁移变更。

Refs #15038；本 PR 不解决该 issue。

The latest repair also cancels old-session follow/animation callbacks and strengthens continued-follow assertions. It carries the two smoke selector corrections already landed in #15860. These new cases were not run locally; current-head CI remains pending.

prs.title: fix(release): derive the next patch when the preview baseline lags latest
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a stable release is dispatched without an explicit version, the version resolver promotes the base version of the latest preview. If a stable patch shipped after that preview, the preview base lags the published `latest`, and the resolver used to refuse its own derived version as retrograde, failing the Release workflow's `prepare` job at `Get the version`. This PR derives the next patch after `latest` in that state instead, mirroring how preview releases already bump past a published stable. Explicit `version` input handling, nightly resolution, and preview resolution are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Release run 42231650472 failed in `prepare` and filed issue #16466. The dispatched branch's parent was exactly main's tip at the time, and the same failure reproduces on main today, so this is not branch staleness. With the current registry state (`preview` is `0.26.3-preview.0`, `latest` is `0.26.8`), every versionless stable dispatch fails before any validation runs, even though the only non-retrograde answer — `0.26.9` — is unambiguous. The preview path already handles its mirror-image state by bumping past the published stable; the stable path had no equivalent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On `main`, run `IS_NIGHTLY=false IS_PREVIEW=false MANUAL_VERSION='' node scripts/get-release-version.js --type=stable` and confirm it exits 1 with `Derived stable version 0.26.3 is lower than published latest 0.26.8. Refusing retrograde baseline.` On this branch, run the same command and confirm it exits 0 and prints `"releaseTag": "v0.26.9"` with `"previousReleaseTag": "v0.26.8"`. Then run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/get-release-version.test.js` and confirm 53 passing tests.

Optionally dispatch the Release workflow with `dry_run=true` and a blank version: `Prepare Release Metadata` should now complete instead of failing at `Get the version`. Keeping `dry_run=true` avoids the failure-notifier path that filed the issue.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (main, current npm dist-tags):

```text
$ IS_NIGHTLY=false IS_PREVIEW=false MANUAL_VERSION='' node scripts/get-release-version.js --type=stable
Error: Derived stable version 0.26.3 is lower than published latest 0.26.8. Refusing retrograde baseline.
EXIT=1
```

After (this branch, same registry):

```text
$ IS_NIGHTLY=false IS_PREVIEW=false MANUAL_VERSION='' node scripts/get-release-version.js --type=stable
{
  "releaseTag": "v0.26.9",
  "releaseVersion": "0.26.9",
  "npmTag": "latest",
  "previousReleaseTag": "v0.26.8"
}
EXIT=0
Preview baseline 0.26.3 is at or below published latest 0.26.8; bumping the stable base to 0.26.9.
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.2 on a Linux checkout, with the real npm registry for the version-resolution probe and the repository's scripts Vitest suite for the unit tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a versionless manual stable dispatch now selects the next patch after `latest` instead of failing. The candidate version still passes every existing existence check (all published packages, git tags, GitHub releases) and the push-time `assert-release-version` guard, and an explicit `version` input still takes precedence.
- Not validated / out of scope: dispatching the live Release workflow, because this runner has no GitHub credentials. The closest surrogate is the exact version-resolution command the `prepare` job runs, executed against the real npm registry.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Nightly and preview version resolution are untouched.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16466

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当维护者在不填写显式版本的情况下分发 stable 发布时，版本解析器会提升最新 preview 的基线版本。如果在该 preview 之后又发布了 stable 补丁版本，preview 基线就会落后于已发布的 `latest`，而解析器过去会把自己推导出的版本当作"版本回退"拒绝，导致 Release 工作流的 `prepare` 任务在 `Get the version` 步骤失败。本 PR 在该状态下改为从 `latest` 之后的下一个补丁版本推导，这与 preview 发布在遇到已发布 stable 时已经采用的提升方式一致。显式 `version` 输入的处理、nightly 解析和 preview 解析均不变。

## 为什么需要

Release 运行 42231650472 在 `prepare` 中失败并创建了 issue #16466。被分发运行的分支其父提交恰好是当时 main 的最新提交，而且同样的失败今天在 main 上仍可复现，所以这不是分支基线过期。在当前 registry 状态下（`preview` 为 `0.26.3-preview.0`，`latest` 为 `0.26.8`），每一次不带版本的 stable 分发都会在任何校验运行之前失败，尽管唯一不回退的答案——`0.26.9`——是明确无歧义的。preview 路径已经通过对已发布 stable 进行提升来处理它的镜像状态；stable 路径此前没有对应处理。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `main` 上运行 `IS_NIGHTLY=false IS_PREVIEW=false MANUAL_VERSION='' node scripts/get-release-version.js --type=stable`，确认它以退出码 1 失败并输出 `Derived stable version 0.26.3 is lower than published latest 0.26.8. Refusing retrograde baseline.`。在本分支上运行同一条命令，确认它以退出码 0 结束并输出 `"releaseTag": "v0.26.9"` 以及 `"previousReleaseTag": "v0.26.8"`。然后运行 `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/get-release-version.test.js`，确认 53 个测试通过。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

修改前（main，当前 npm dist-tags）：

```text
$ IS_NIGHTLY=false IS_PREVIEW=false MANUAL_VERSION='' node scripts/get-release-version.js --type=stable
Error: Derived stable version 0.26.3 is lower than published latest 0.26.8. Refusing retrograde baseline.
EXIT=1
```

修改后（本分支，同一 registry）：

```text
$ IS_NIGHTLY=false IS_PREVIEW=false MANUAL_VERSION='' node scripts/get-release-version.js --type=stable
{
  "releaseTag": "v0.26.9",
  "releaseVersion": "0.26.9",
  "npmTag": "latest",
  "previousReleaseTag": "v0.26.8"
}
EXIT=0
Preview baseline 0.26.3 is at or below published latest 0.26.8; bumping the stable base to 0.26.9.
```

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 检出目录上的 Node.js 22.23.2，版本解析探针使用真实 npm registry，单元测试使用仓库的 scripts Vitest 套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：不带版本的 manual stable 分发现在会选择 `latest` 之后的下一个补丁版本，而不是失败。候选版本仍会经过所有现有存在性检查（全部已发布包、git tag、GitHub release）以及推送时的 `assert-release-version` 守卫，显式 `version` 输入仍然优先。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：实际分发 Release 工作流，因为该 runner 没有 GitHub 凭据。最接近的替代验证是 `prepare` 任务所执行的同一条版本解析命令，针对真实 npm registry 运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。nightly 与 preview 版本解析不受影响。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16466

prs.title: fix(permissions): match amend invocations instead of raw text
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The AUTO-mode amend guard now matches parsed shell invocations instead of testing the raw command text. It splits compound commands, strips heredoc bodies, unwraps shell wrappers, skips transparent execution prefixes, and only then checks for a `git commit` invocation carrying `--amend`.

The guard still recognizes absolute git paths, `.exe` paths, environment assignments, `sudo`/`env`/`timeout`-style prefixes, shell wrappers, control-flow keywords, and `eval`.

Since the R9 review round the recognizer is an improvement layer, not a replacement: a fail-closed backstop re-tests the original substring pattern over the raw command plus its wrapper-stripped form, and denies every literal occurrence the recognizer did not confirm unless a narrow prover shows each occurrence is inert data. The recognizer can therefore only add denials, never remove one the original guard made. Inert proof is deliberately small: single-quoted arguments, `#` comments, and single-quoted-delimiter heredoc bodies of `echo`, `printf`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `wc`, `ls`. Anything the prover cannot positively classify is denied.

The session-commit exemption is also repository-scoped now: when the command relocates the repository (`-C`, `--git-dir`, `--work-tree`, `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE`), the exemption checks the HEAD of the repository the command actually targets, and only when exactly one relocation with a static literal absolute path can be resolved. Unresolvable relocations refuse the exemption; commands without relocation flags behave exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13570 reported that commands containing no git invocation were hard-blocked merely because their text mentioned `git commit --amend`. This affected bug reports, tests, changelog entries, commit-message arguments, grep patterns, and heredocs.

The previous substring match was also easy to defeat through indirection. Parsing actual command segments fixes the false positives the prover can certify, while the backstop keeps the guard fail-closed for everything else — the R9 reviews showed the recognizer alone missed real amends in unclassifiable constructs, which this structure now denies by default.

This PR addresses defect 1 in #13570 only, and only for the inert forms listed above. #13636 already fixed the destructive-denial escalation path; the policy changes for the user-prompt escape hatch, `pmForcedAsk` ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering are intentionally out of scope here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

With AUTO mode active and no session commit registered, run a command whose amend phrase is provably inert data: `echo 'git commit --amend'`, `grep 'git commit --amend' file.txt`, `printf '%s' 'git commit --amend'`, a `# git commit --amend` comment, or a single-quoted-delimiter heredoc fed to `cat`. These reach normal permission evaluation instead of the destructive-command denial.

Then try actual amends through common spellings: `git commit --amend --no-edit`, `/usr/bin/git commit --amend`, `git -c core.editor=true commit --amend`, `bash -c 'git commit --amend'`, `sudo env GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=now git commit --amend`, `timeout 10 git commit --amend`, `if true; then git commit --amend; fi`, and `eval 'git commit --amend'`. These remain blocked when HEAD was not registered as a session commit — including the eleven recognizer-missed spellings from the R9 review (here-string-fed shells, comment-smuggled payloads, executor-wrapped forms), which the backstop now denies.

For the exemption scoping: register repo A's HEAD as a session commit, then from repo A run `git -C <repo B> commit --amend` — blocked, because repo B's HEAD is not registered; the reverse direction is allowed.

### Known limitations (stay blocked, fail-closed)

The prover only certifies the narrow inert forms above. These #13570 scenarios remain blocked and are pinned as such in the tests:

- Double-quoted inert text: `echo "git commit --amend"`, `grep -n "git commit --amend" CHANGELOG.md`, `git log --grep="git commit --amend"`.
- Executable-host payloads even when quoted: `node -e 'console.log("… git commit --amend …")'`.
- Unquoted phrase with a redirect: `echo git commit --amend >> CHANGELOG.md` (R1 from the R9 review).
- Here-strings and redirect-bearing heredocs: `echo bash <<< 'git commit --amend'`, `cat > notes.txt <<'EOF' … EOF`.
- Compound commands mixing inert and non-inert segments.

Each of these was also blocked by the original substring guard, so the PR does not regress them; extending the inert proof to them is follow-up work. The `--am` abbreviation gap predates this PR and is likewise follow-up.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This is a permission-parser change with unit coverage, not a user-visible layout change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local at the R9 head: `destructive-commands.test.ts` + `shell-semantics.test.ts` 364/364, the full `src/permissions` suite 1505/1505 across 16 files, `prettier --check` and ESLint clean on all changed files. Load-bearing red checks: disabling the backstop turns exactly the 27 R9 additions red; disabling the exemption scoping turns exactly 7 red while the no-flag test stays green. Windows/Linux and the rest of `packages/core` are CI's.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The guard is fail-closed by construction — any construct the prover cannot positively classify as inert is denied, so the false-positive surface is the original guard's minus the certified inert forms, and the false-negative surface is strictly smaller than the original guard's. The cost is that some genuinely inert spellings (listed under Known limitations) stay blocked until the prover grows; that is the deliberate direction of the R9 review.
- Not validated / out of scope: The prompt-based escape hatch, user `ask`-rule ordering, and `skipClassifierReason` ordering from #13570 are not changed in this PR. Non-blocking R9 suggestions (shared shell word reader, `$'…'` escape decoding, last-here-string semantics, monitor `--` handling, direct `stripShellWrapper` unit tests) are deferred to a follow-up issue recorded in the thread.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13570

prs.title: feat(core): name the active shell in the startup context
prs.body:
## Summary

The startup context tells the model the OS platform but not the shell that will run its commands. On Windows that gap costs turns: `getShellConfiguration()` (`packages/core/src/utils/shell-utils.ts:183`) resolves to `cmd.exe` unless `MSYSTEM`/`TERM` mark a Git Bash session, and a model assuming a POSIX shell writes `a; b`, `head`, `wc` — each one failing as a separate call.

This adds one line to the startup context, next to the existing platform line:

```
My operating system is: win32
Shell commands run under: cmd.exe
```

- The name comes from `getShellDisplayName()`, which was private to `packages/core/src/tools/shell.ts` and is now exported from `shell-utils.ts`. The `run_shell_command` description already advertises the same name, so the prompt and the tool description cannot disagree. `shell.ts` now uses the shared helper in both places it needs it.
- The name is derived from the executable `getShellConfiguration()` actually returns, so a `pwsh.exe` session is described as `pwsh.exe`, not as Windows PowerShell 5.1.
- A session running against a remote execution environment omits the line, together with the local platform line: the command does not run under the local shell.

## Validation

- `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/environmentContext.test.ts src/tools/shell.test.ts src/utils/shell-utils.test.ts src/core/client.test.ts` — 1291 tests pass.
- Added `names the shell that will run the command` and extended the remote-execution-environment test to assert the line is omitted there.
- `npx tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit` — clean.
- `npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint` on the four changed files — clean.
- Not run: full `npm run build`, and no live session on Windows. The rendering was verified through `getEnvironmentContext()` on this platform (darwin/bash); the cmd.exe and PowerShell branches are covered by the existing `shell.test.ts` description tests, not by a live Windows run.

Part of #15310 — this delivers the first half (state the effective shell). The second half, letting the operator choose the shell explicitly, is not covered here and is deliberately left open.

prs.title: feat(qqbot): let the agent send a local file to the chat
prs.body:
## What this PR does

It lets the agent hand media back to a QQ chat. A new per-channel switch, off by default, exposes four tools that each take an absolute local path: one sends a file, one an image, one a video, and one a voice message. The channel checks that the file really is a regular file inside the session's workspace or the system temporary directory (symlinks are resolved and refused when they escape, paths with more than one hard link are refused, and the opened descriptor is re-checked), then uploads it through the platform's chunked upload path and sends it as a rich-media message. The image, video, and voice tools also check the file's magic bytes and its per-kind soft limit before any upload, so a file the platform would render as something else — a GIF, a WebP, an over-limit image — is refused with a pointer to the file tool instead of being quietly downgraded to a file card. Every send reuses the turn's reply anchor and message-sequence counter, so media sent mid-turn stays in the same reply chain as that turn's text; when the reply window has closed it falls back to an active message, and when active messages are disabled it reports the refusal instead of dropping the media or silently replacing it with text. Upload failures are reported to the model with the platform's error code classified, so a retryable part failure can be retried and a daily-limit rejection is not.

## Why it's needed

An agent working in a channel could read a conversation and write files, but had no supported way to deliver one to the user: images, videos, and voice messages could come in, and text could go out, but a report, a generated archive, a chart, a short clip, or a voice note produced locally had to be retrieved by hand from the machine. The tools close that gap with the same ownership rule as the other adapter tools — a tool is only offered to sessions of the channel that registered it. The platform renders an image, a video, and a voice message differently from a file card, so the sender picks the form the user should see instead of every artifact arriving as a download.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Enable the new file switch on a QQ channel and, from a session in that chat, ask the agent to send a file it created inside the workspace; a file card should arrive in the chat and the send should belong to the same reply chain as that turn's text. Then confirm the boundary: a path outside the workspace and outside the temporary directory is refused, a symlink pointing outside is refused, a file over the size cap is refused before any upload, and with the switch off the tool is not registered at all. In a chat where active messages are disabled, force the turn's reply window to close and confirm the tool reports the refusal rather than sending text. Then ask the same session for a generated PNG, an MP4, and a WAV (or MP3/SILK/OGG): the chat should receive an image message, a playable video, and a voice bar, each still in that turn's reply chain. Hand the image tool a GIF or a 21 MB PNG and confirm it is refused before any upload with the accepted formats and the file-tool fallback named, instead of arriving as a file card.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — channel-side tools, no TUI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; the platform upload and send paths are exercised with a mocked HTTP layer. Local verification at this head: `file-tools.test.ts` + `api.test.ts` 85/85, `send.test.ts` + `events.test.ts` 368/368, `tsc --build packages/channels/qqbot` exit 0.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the tools hand a local file to the platform under the bot's own identity, so they are opt-in per channel and bounded to the session workspace, the temporary directory, and a per-kind size cap (20 MiB for files, 20 MB for images and voice messages, 30 MB for videos); the path and format checks are the security-relevant part.
- Not validated / out of scope: a real end-to-end send against the live QQ platform. The accepted format lists come from the platform's documentation, which disagrees with itself on image and voice formats (the file-type table says `png`/`jpg` and `silk`, the overview text also lists `gif`/`webp`/`bmp` and `mp3`/`wav`/`ogg`); the design follows the table for images and the wider list for voice, and a format the platform rejects comes back as its own error with a fallback to the file tool. The bilingual design document is at `docs/design/2026-10-25-qqbot-outbound-media.md`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the switch defaults off and the change adds a new option and tool rather than changing existing behaviour.

## Linked Issues

The adapter-tool pipeline these tools are exposed through landed as #14348 (now in `main`); this branch has `main` merged into it, so the diff contains only the outbound-media increments.
